NEI is EVEN MORE POWERFUL NOW?

allInOneQuestsList.name: No Self-Healing Tools Here...Yet
allInOneQuestsList.data:
In this pack you have to first gain expertise in Thaumcraft to craft the Tinker's Construct Ball of Moss. Go and become a dangerous wizard, and you'll gain the power needed to craft the Ball of Moss and make your tools heal themselves. Of course, you need to get to the Twilight Forest and get some aluminium ingots before you can begin. The Ball of Moss is in the GTNH tab of the Thaumonomicon, and requires infusion. There are many other great things in the Thaumonomicon, but be wary of warp.

Have a beer to prepare for your long journey.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lNo Self-Healing Tools Here...Yet
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
No Self-Healing Tools Here...Yet
Prequest requests:
Making Better Tools

allInOneQuestsList.name: Not Enough Items - Now with Bookmarks and Recent History!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
More like too many items! Here are some tips for using NEI.

When you have your inventory open, you can type the search terms in the text bar at the bottom. Make sure your GUI size is set correctly, or you won't be able to see it. Double-click the bar to highlight any matching items in your inventory or inventories you're looking at. Handy for searching for a specific ore, as they tend to look the same!

Even better, you can use T to search nearby inventories, which will emit some particles.

We have also provided the special Y command to look for a machine in the world, in case you've forgotten where you placed that Advanced Circuit Assembler.

We now have an extra-fancy Bookmark feature! The default key is A, but can be changed in the NEI config window. Bookmarks will be on the left side of the inventory, and you can look up their recipes or uses as normal. To move a bookmark, drag it with Shift+LMB. You can even bookmark entire recipes with Shift+A or recipes with amounts using Ctrl+Shift+A.

Pressing O will hide NEI, useful for fancy screenshots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lNot Enough Items - Now with Bookmarks and Recent History!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Not Enough Items - Now with Bookmarks and Recent History!
Prequest requests:
Ready, Set, Go!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Options For Finding Zinc in This Tier
allInOneQuestsList.data:
It can be hard to find Zinc Gravel Ore on old servers or unlucky world seeds.

The alternatives are:
- Buy the zinc gravel in the Coins Coins coins tab,
- Searching for small zinc ore in the overworld,
- A recipe with XP buckets on a crafting table.

Once you reach LV, you can get zinc from processing various ores like antimony, sphalerite, tetrahedrite and tin.
Check NEI for more options.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lOptions For Finding Zinc in This Tier
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Options For Finding Zinc in This Tier
Prequest requests:
Upgrade 2.0

allInOneQuestsList.name: Personally, I Prefer Pepsi™
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You may have noticed that you can make more than just Charcoal in a Coke Oven, you can also make Coke.

You want to save all of your Coke for making Steel in your Bricked Blast Furnace (BBF) later on. As for everything else, check NEI for the uses of each Coal variant, since there are many.

[note]Once you get to the Steam Age, you can compress your Sugar and Cactus Coke for higher efficiency just like regular Coal and Charcoal.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lPersonally, I Prefer Pepsi™
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Personally, I Prefer Pepsi™
Prequest requests:
Finally, Some Powerful Fuel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Punji Sticks
allInOneQuestsList.data: An early game protection moat can be made out of punji sticks. It hurts all mobs/players and additionally gives a slowness II potion effect. Make a trench around your base and put the punji sticks inside.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lPunji Sticks
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Punji Sticks
Prequest requests:
Cotton, Cotton and More Cotton

allInOneQuestsList.name: Rare Ores
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Did you look for days to find Diamonds, Redstone, Tantalite, Certus Quartz, or Mica?

Well for a few mixes you can use different ores like Coal for Diamond Vein or Quarzite Ore for Certus Quartz Vein. Mica ore mix can be found if you have Cassiterite Ore, but not the Cassiterite Sand.

Tetrahedrite in the nether can be found with copper ore.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lRare Ores
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Rare Ores
Prequest requests:
Divine Rod of the Gods?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Ready, Set, Go!
allInOneQuestsList.data: You probably should have a home by now. A steady supply of food is a fundamental requirement at all times. Take this journal to keep track of the things you've eaten. You will have to travel far in this tier, better be prepared!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lReady, Set, Go!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Redstone
allInOneQuestsList.data: If you didn't find any Redstone veins yet, it is quite important to look for one now. Try your luck at Y 5-40.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lRedstone

allInOneQuestsList.name: Redstone, Early Game Processing
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Are you wondering how to process raw redstone ore without a macerator?

Use the hammer in the crafting table to get some crushed redstone ore from your raw redstone ore. After that, use the hammer in the crafting table again to get some impure redstone dust.

Lastly, fill a cauldron with water and drop the whole stack of dust into it, either manually or by pressing Ctrl+Q. The cauldron can handle the entire stack with the same amount of water. You will get pure redstone dust for your redstone needs.

§3You could also take the hammer with you on your mining trip and break the redstone ore with it directly to get crushed redstone ore, thus skipping the raw redstone ore.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §1§2§lRedstone, Early Game Processing

allInOneQuestsList.name: Redstone? Haste!
allInOneQuestsList.data: Mining and digging can be soooo slow. Get some redstone on your pick, shovel or axe to make it faster. You can use the Crafting Station to upgrade your tool 8 dust at a time. Later when you get a compressor you can use blocks to do 9 per block.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lRedstone? Haste!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sand: The Gathering
allInOneQuestsList.data: In a strange vision you saw a big structure which would allow you to make charcoal. Finally some torches! According to your calculations, you will need a lot of sand for that.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lSand: The Gathering

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sheep Hairdresser
allInOneQuestsList.data: Killing sheep to get the wool is so inefficient. Making some shears would make sense if you need more wool.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lSheep Hairdresser

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sleeping Outside
allInOneQuestsList.data: Carrying the bed with you all the time looks very funny. Why don't you craft a sleeping bag to stay outside without placing a bed and changing your spawn point? This way if you die, you'll be right at home!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lSleeping Outside

allInOneQuestsList.name: Something to Carry Liquids
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You tried to move water with your bare hands, which didn't work at all. Luckily, you remember how to make a bucket out of clay dust.

Put it in a mortar to get small clay dust which can be crafted to clay dust.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lSomething to Carry Liquids
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Something to Carry Liquids
Prequest requests:
Macerator v0.1 Alpha
Clay: The Gathering

allInOneQuestsList.name: Stick a Finger in the Air
allInOneQuestsList.data:
But you really do care. Trying to find a good place to locate a windmill? You could just build one and see, or try this fancy windsock.

Paper rotors are great in low winds.
Wool rotors are cheap.
Leather rotors are durable.

Don't leave the rotors in the windmill when you aren't using it, it will use up durability.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lStick a Finger in the Air
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Stick a Finger in the Air
Prequest requests:
Circle Shapes Give Me Comfort

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sustainable Paper
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now that you got your first paper, it's time for a better way to get more. With paperbark you can do just that.

Once grown you can obtain paper by right-clicking the logs of the tree. The bark regrows in due time.
allInOneQuestsList.title: Sustainable Paper

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tanned Leather
allInOneQuestsList.data: You have found a way to make leather more durable and resistant by further processing it. Make some bound leather from four pieces of leather, some strings and woven cotton. Now you only have to hang it on a drying rack and wait about 10 minutes to get some tanned leather. Stockpile some for later.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lTanned Leather

allInOneQuestsList.name: The power of prospecting!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
At the top of your map screen (J by default) there are multiple tabs, some of them will be very useful and will save you a ton of searching!

GT Oreveins - this tab will keep track of the veins for you, to save a vein to map right-click a naturally generated ore (some tools can't right-click)
GT Underground fluids - this will help you later (MV)
TC Nodes - this tab will keep track of thaumcraft nodes for you (you need to scan them first)

[note]Small Ores are not part of veins and thus do not uncover a vein on the map. However veins generate extra small ores related to the vein in their chunks, so they can still be useful in your search (though not all small ores are related to a nearby vein so don't be fooled).[/note]

[note]Another great interaction is that you can use the NEI search bar in highlight mode (double-click it) and then go to the map screen to get the matching uncovered ore veins highlighted![/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lThe power of prospecting!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
The power of prospecting!
Prequest requests:
How the Heck Do I Find Ores?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tin
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tin ingots can be created by smelting Tin, Cassiterite, or Cassiterite Sand ore. Tin and Cassiterite ores are only found at high altitudes, but Cassiterite Sand ore is plentiful near the surface.

If you get lucky and find a high altitude Tin/Cassiterite vein, save one of the Cassiterite ore to find a Mica vein later on using the ore finder wand.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lTin

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tinker-Time
allInOneQuestsList.data:
While using your wooden tools is fun in terms of killing pigs and cows, they are not long-lasting and can't be repaired. Plus Infernals laugh at your attempts to kill them. You discovered how to craft tools that can be repaired and upgraded, but for that you definitely need a more advanced crafting technique.

[note]If you don't have access to oak wood for creating your Part Builder, you can shapelessly craft yours into the oak variant for purposes of completing this quest[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lTinker-Time

allInOneQuestsList.name: Too Many Leaves
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want to clear out shrubbery but don't want to pull out leaves by hand? Need to find that last log hidden in the middle of a bunch of leaves?

Try an Iron Scythe! When used, it clears out a 5x5x5 area of leaves, crops, flowers, or grass. Excellent for tearing through Sacred Oak leaves or dense shrubbery in certain biomes. Later when you have a Cutting Machine you can upgrade to a Diamond Scythe with a 7x7x7 area of effect, or use Amethyst for 9x9x9 to FLEX.

The lower tiers break leaves instantly but don't seem to have the 3x3x3 range for some reason.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lToo Many Leaves

allInOneQuestsList.name: Upgrade 2.0
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Find iron, copper and tin ore. Very funny... How can you mine these with just a flint pickaxe?

I have an idea; bring me some of the stone you mined with your flint pickaxe and I will give you a better tool head in exchange.

Remember to level it up again either with monster heads or by mining.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§k§l§l§r§2§lUpgrade 2.0
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Upgrade 2.0
Prequest requests:
Your First Tool
Copper Sky, Iron Curtain

allInOneQuestsList.name: When All You Have is a Hammer...
allInOneQuestsList.data:
...the whole world looks like a nail.

When looking for good tool materials, see "GregTech Material Tools" tab in NEI. Remember that NEI bookmarks are your friends.

The GT tools each have special uses.

§lScrewdriver§r - Used on covers to change their behavior or on machines to change their input mode.

§lWrench§r - Used to change the output direction on a GT machine, or to break it. Can also disconnect/connect pipes or enable their built in shutter.

§lCrowbar§r - Remove covers from machines or pipes.

§lWire cutters§r - Connecting/disconnecting/breaking wires/cables.

§lSoft mallet§r - Turning machines on/off.

§lHammer§r - Prospecting for ores in a limited way in front of you, smashing ore blocks into crushed ores, and muffling machine sounds.

§lPlunger§r - Drain fluids from a machine or tank

[note]On a side note, Tin Pipes need a Steel Wrench to dismantle, so don't place them randomly, and pay attention to material levels![/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lWhen All You Have is a Hammer...
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
When All You Have is a Hammer...
Prequest requests:
Important Tools

allInOneQuestsList.name: Wooden Door
allInOneQuestsList.data:
For your new House you need some wooden doors. Well, the recipe is really hard and needs iron/copper and a lot of wood.

You can choose two more doors as a reward if you like.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lWooden Door

allInOneQuestsList.name: XP Usage?!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Exploring some dungeons or fighting mobs probably gave you a lot of XP. Better use it to get iron, copper, tin, or other useful dusts before you die.

Place your tank on the ground and a drain on top. Now you can fill it with XP.

By the way, you discovered that while the seared tank doesn't hold much, it doesn't lose contents when broken, and full tanks can stack. I wonder if that information is useful...
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lXP Usage?!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
XP Usage?!
Prequest requests:
Important Tools
You Are Now Prepared, Hopefully!

allInOneQuestsList.name: You Need MOOOOOOORE Wood
allInOneQuestsList.data:
It's time to feed your new coke oven with some wood to get more charcoal. You're looking for the most efficient way to plant trees. Try to find some spruce saplings and some jungle saplings. Both can be planted in a 2x2 grid to get bigger trees.

[warn]Warning label: Do not put your pets in the microwave to dry them. And do not plant any of these rewards in the middle of your base.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYou Need MOOOOOOORE Wood

allInOneQuestsList.name: You Need Them All!
allInOneQuestsList.data: There are many more backpacks: Hunter, builder, forester...
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYou Need Them All!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You Need Them All!
Prequest requests:
Need More Space?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your First Bow
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Since vanilla bows are only craftable in the assembling machine and mobs don't drop them very often you should make a Tinkers bow.

Wood would be the best material for now. Craft the bow limbs out of wood and the bow string out of strings. The arrow that has the most durability is bone, so craft the stick out of bone. It is much lighter but less durable than a regular arrow. Use a flint tip to make it repairable with flint.

You can repair your bow the same way as all the other Tinkers tools. The arrows can be regained by repairing them or picking them up from the floor. The arrows should be in your inventory if you want to pick up the ones you fired. You can't pick them up if they are in Battlegear slots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYour First Bow

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your First Flint Sword
allInOneQuestsList.data:
It's time to upgrade your wooden sword a little.
Collect flint bones and a stick.

You won't be able to kill a Wither with it now, but you can upgrade and improve this tool later. You can also repair it with flint.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYour First Flint Sword

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your First Flint Throwing Knife
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Is the bone bow too expensive for your taste? Then make a flint throwing knife instead. You need flint and a stick to get 12 knives. The durability and the attack damage are very low but it still helps with killing mobs from a safe distance.

The knives should be in your inventory if you want to pick up the ones you fired.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYour First Flint Throwing Knife

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your First Tool
allInOneQuestsList.data:
When your tinkers tables are ready, you can craft your first §oreal§r tool. If you didn't find a village yet to grab some parts from the chest, you can only craft flint tools.

Let's start with a pickaxe, an axe, and a shovel.

Keep in mind that most of the original tool parts from Tinker's Construct are not shown in NEI. That doesn't mean that you can't craft them - use the tooltips on patterns and molds as guidance.

Your new tools are weak at first, but the more you use them the better they will get. You get a modifier slot after some levels, needing more as you level it up. They will level up to level 99 if you play long enough, with 20 modifier slots. Tool parts can be replaced for a bit of level XP, however the tool must be fully repaired first.

You need to level up the mining level each time you replace the parts to unleash the full power of the pickaxe. Stone->Copper for this pickaxe. If you manage to get a Zombie, Skeleton, or Creeper head, you can use it to skip the level-up process. This doesn't use up a modifier level, but does change the look until you change the pickaxe part out.

Item=Usable when mining level is X or less
Zombie=1
Skeleton=2
Creeper=4
Wither Skeleton=7
Nether Star=8

You could use a paper binding to add an extra modifier, but you will also get modifiers with tool levels.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYour First Tool

allInOneQuestsList.name: You Shall Proceed
allInOneQuestsList.data:
As you've gathered and crafted all materials and tools you need for your basic steam machinery, you may now proceed to the next tier. Keep in mind that you'll need mountains of resources in order to craft even the simplest things, so you probably should stock up on all ores in this tier. But that's up to you.

As a special reward, you get a pair of Holo Glasses to look inside your inventories. Place it into the mask slot, and use the keybind to turn it on.

[note]Tip: If you double-click the NEI search field the resulting highlighted search also applies to what you can see with your Holo Glasses![/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lYou Shall Proceed
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You Shall Proceed
Prequest requests:
Making Bronze
Important Tools
When All You Have is a Hammer...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Zinc Gravel
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You can find it in chunks of gravel on the surface.

Use as little as possible and save the rest for when you get a macerator in Steam age, you'll get twice as much.

If you can't find any, you can buy them in the Coins tab.

If you get enough and fully process it, you can also get gallium for gallium arsenide in LV age.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lZinc Gravel

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Better Way to Find Items
allInOneQuestsList.data:
NEI has a built in search feature for finding an item stored in an inventory nearby. A Stockroom Catalog can give you a list of everything stored in your inventories.

Sneak-right-click a block with an inventory (a chest, bookcase, barrel, anything with an inventory) to add that inventory to the list of inventories for the catalog to keep track of.

Sneak-right-click the same block again to remove that block from the list.

A small particle effect will render on any block that has been selected with the catalog when holding the Stockroom Catalog to let you know that block is being tracked.

Right-click to open the GUI and see the list. You can sort the list in ascending or descending order by quantity (Count) or alphabetical order.

You can also see a list of all the inventories that have a particular item and easily add the location of one of those inventories to a stockroom catalog so you can easily find your stuff.

The Stockroom Catalog can also be copied with the typesetting table and printing press.

Click on the title to change it to anything so you can custom label your stockroom catalog.

Click on the small chest icons on the right hand side of each listing to open the inventory list view.

If you want, you can craft a waypoint compass and use that to point you towards the chest. Since we have JourneyMaps and NEI, it's not really necessary.

[warn]The Catalog seems to be a bit broken though and doesn't work well with GT items.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lA Better Way to Find Items
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A Better Way to Find Items

Books

allInOneQuestsList.name: Accelerated Plant Growth
allInOneQuestsList.data: As you might've discovered by now, plants grow very slowly. So why don't you try to speed that up a little? A watering can will come in handy.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lAccelerated Plant Growth

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Clear View
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Are you still living in your dirt/cobble hut? How about letting in some sunlight? Grind up some sand and flint and craft some glass dust. Put it in your smeltery and pour it into a casting basin to make clear glass.

[note]Hint: In order to use it for recipes, you have to chisel it.[/note]

[note]PS: The macerator no longer gives tiny piles, just uncraft a normal pile to get tiny ones. You'll appreciate this once you have a mixer in LV.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lA Clear View
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A Clear View
Prequest requests:
The Hell is That?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Solar Boilers
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Once you have some Steam machines, you can make Advanced Solar Boilers. They have more Steam output per second. Otherwise they are the same as Simple Solar Boilers.

Fill it with Water on the bottom side to produce Steam. Unlike the other Boilers, this only outputs Steam on the output port side.

Hint: The Advanced Solar Boiler calcifies and becomes less efficient over time - but it will only drop to 120L/s, not 40L/s, like the Simple Solar Boiler. Later on you can consider using Distilled Water to avoid calcification.

[note]You'll need Silver from the Twilight Forest (LV+) or from small ores for this.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lAdvanced Solar Boilers
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Advanced Solar Boilers
Prequest requests:
Better Than Iron
Time to Get Some Steel
The Power of the Sun

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Fool Fit for a King
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Only the craziest fool would use diamonds to make a tool! Or is it crazy like a fox?

§3PS: You can also §oburn them for fuel§r§3 for that extra bit of craziness.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lA Fool Fit for a King
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A Fool Fit for a King
Prequest requests:
Ooo, Shiny! (Not Platinum!)

allInOneQuestsList.name: Another Use for Java, I Mean Lava
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now that you have Steel, you can craft a sturdy enough Boiler to handle Lava. Steam is only outputted in the back, and you require Water input on the side and Lava input on the top. But as an added benefit, this Boiler will reward you with Obsidian!

§3Did you know? Over 3 billion machines run on Lava!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lAnother Use for Java, I Mean Lava
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Another Use for Java, I Mean Lava
Prequest requests:
Where Can I Put All the Liquids?
Steam Alternatives
Time to Get Some Steel

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Quite Different Storage
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Regular chests can fill up rather quickly if you happen to collect mob drops like swords and/or armor. By using a cabinet, you can store up to 270 items of the same type. Also, it doesn't need a dolly - you can break it normally and it will retain contents.

Perfect for storing IC2 crop seeds, Forestry saplings, or bees!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lA Quite Different Storage

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Very Important Alloy
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The most important alloy (until you reach a higher tier) is undoubtedly red alloy. Fortunately, you have an alloy smelter, so grab some redstone and combine it with copper to get yourself a handful of that.

Don't confuse your bronze with your copper or else you'll be scratching your head.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lA Very Important Alloy
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A Very Important Alloy

More Advanced Alloys

allInOneQuestsList.data: Are your cobblestone or dirt barrels filled to the brim? No problem, upgrade them!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBarrel Upgrades
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Barrel Upgrades

allInOneQuestsList.name: Barrel Upgrades Tier 2
allInOneQuestsList.data: Are your upgraded cobblestone or dirt barrels full again? No problem, upgrade them some more!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBarrel Upgrades Tier 2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Barrel Upgrades Tier 3
allInOneQuestsList.data: Are your upgraded cobblestone or dirt barrels full again? No problem, upgrade them some more!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Crafting: Machine Hulls
allInOneQuestsList.data:
All machines need a hull to keep their private parts together. Good news is: They are crafted in the same way for every tier, only the materials change.

§3As noted on the tooltip, you can also use a machine hull to pass EU through, at 1A. This can be useful for a 1A diode on Thermos servers, splitting cables from 4A->1A or in a cleanroom later. You can also pass items or fluids through it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBasic Crafting: Machine Hulls
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Basic Crafting: Machine Hulls
Prequest requests:
Wired, Weird?!
Better Than Iron

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Crafting: Motors
allInOneQuestsList.data: Motors are little devices that can turn electrical power into rotational energy. Very useful for all kind of machines, and not that difficult to craft. The pattern is always the same, only the materials change with tiers. For now you can use redstone to magnetize your iron rod. Later on you will build an Electromagnetic Polarizer.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBasic Crafting: Motors

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Crafting: Rotors
allInOneQuestsList.data: Rotors are also crafted using an identical pattern with different materials. A bit annoying to craft at the moment, but you don't need a lot of them anyway.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBasic Crafting: Rotors
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Basic Crafting: Rotors
Prequest requests:
Basic Crafting: Machine Hulls

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic > Steam Lootbag Trade
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Trade three Basic lootbags to get a better one: Steam.

After you've completed the Steam tab and head into LV you will unlock recipes to uptier your lootbags in the assembler, but for now here is a quest to do so! (Repeatable)
allInOneQuestsList.title: Basic > Steam Lootbag Trade
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Basic > Steam Lootbag Trade
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 0.5, Steam!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Better Make that Two!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You may need a second anvil!

One would have been for the Forge Hammer and another for general repairing or renaming!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBetter Make that Two!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Better Tank... Iron Tank
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Storing more than 16 buckets of fluid in one tank? Sure! Just make an iron tank or upgrade the Buildcraft tank.

Diamond tanks carry up to 64 buckets and obsidian ones are blast proof. There's even more past that, but you should probably use GT tanks or large cells instead.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBetter Tank... Iron Tank
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Better Tank... Iron Tank
Prequest requests:
Where Can I Put All the Liquids?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Better Than Iron
allInOneQuestsList.data:
But not as good as steel. Mostly, this is used in machine hulls, or in tools if you don't want to use steel up for that.

To make wrought iron, you need a tinkers smelter to melt some iron ingots down and cast nuggets; or use an ingot and a saw to get your nuggets. Now put these in a furnace to get wrought iron nuggets. With the compressor, you can compress the nuggets into ingots.

§3Hint: Crushed or purified iron ore (not a mixed version like pyrite, look for Iron Ore in Chalcopyrite veins) can be smelted to iron nuggets directly. Or you can use an alloy smelter to turn iron ingots into nuggets faster than a smeltery. You can also use a saw to cut up iron ingots into nuggets.

Later on, you can use an arc furnace to make wrought iron ingots directly.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBetter Than Iron

allInOneQuestsList.name: Blastoff!
allInOneQuestsList.data: It's about time to make some steel. Look in the Multiblock Goals quest tab and build a Bricked Blast Furnace. Return here once you've made at least 8 steel ingots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBlastoff!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Books
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Books can be found easily enough in villages or in the roguelike dungeons surface brick house. I'm sure they have a recipe too.

Now glue on the other hand...or should I say horse? Try and get a horse inside a smeltery and feed it hay to keep it alive.

Or you can wait until after you go to the Nether and get some sulfur. Either way.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBooks

allInOneQuestsList.name: Bowl Full of Spaghetti
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Or at least factories full of item pipes. With these simple item pipes and conveyors you can take items out of one machine and feed them immediately into a second machine.

Later on you can make better item pipes. Search for "item pipe" in NEI for options.

[warn]You'll need a Steel Wrench to remove them. Don't place them down unless you're sure of the location until you have one.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lBowl Full of Spaghetti

allInOneQuestsList.name: Circuit Boards
allInOneQuestsList.data: For every circuit you need a circuit board. Craft a coated circuit board and use copper wire to finish it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lCircuit Boards

allInOneQuestsList.name: Compressing Stuff
allInOneQuestsList.data: This rather simple device does a very important job: compression. Its main function is to press 9 ingots into a block, but it's also useful for a variety of recipes, for example making firm tofu.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lCompressing Stuff

allInOneQuestsList.name: Copper Barrel
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Copper barrel has 45 slots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lCopper Barrel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Cutting a Tree log by log is so Old School
allInOneQuestsList.data:
By making a lumber axe, you are now able to cut down an entire tree in one hit. Don't forget your backpack when you're cutting a sacred oak down.

Protip: With wooden equivalents of casts, make a lumber axe completely out of netherrack - lower mining speed means less XP needed to level it up. Use the modifier slots to add Reinforced. Once you've leveled it up enough, upgrade the parts for better ones, such as steel, obzinite, or others. The higher-level metals will require an MV Extruder. Keep in mind that the auto-smelt modifier doesn't work, so don't bother with it.

The quest will accept a lumber axe from any material.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lCutting a Tree log by log is so Old School
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Cutting a Tree log by log is so Old School
Prequest requests:
Tool Forge

allInOneQuestsList.name: Extracting Stuff
allInOneQuestsList.data: As you'll need rubber later to make cables from wires, you should get yourself a steam extractor. You can also use this machine to get more dyes from flowers, or process different fruits into juice.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lExtracting Stuff

allInOneQuestsList.name: Extra Modifier
allInOneQuestsList.data:
If you don't have an extra modifier on your tool you can easily add one. A gold block and a diamond are all you need.

You can add two more modifiers, but you'll need to read the tinkers book yourself to know what to use.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lExtra Modifier

allInOneQuestsList.name: Factory Iron Door
allInOneQuestsList.data:
For your new Factory you need iron doors. Unfortunately, the recipe is really hard, needing steel.

You can choose two more iron doors as reward if you like.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lFactory Iron Door

allInOneQuestsList.name: Flaming idiots
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Blazes are all infernals, and all nasty. Avoid like a plague. Get awesome weapons, awesome armor, and prepare for a fight.

The alternative is to figure out a way to destroy them with technology.

The alternative to the alternative is to figure out a different way to get blaze powder and blaze rods.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lFlaming idiots

allInOneQuestsList.name: Flint and Steel
allInOneQuestsList.data:
After you make steel you are able to craft flint and steel. I guess you'll want to travel to the Nether as soon as possible but be aware; the Nether is a very dangerous place.

Note: The ball of moss gives a tinker's tool self-repair. But if the tool is completely broken, it won't repair it.

Note that the flint and steel can take a few times to work.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lFlint and Steel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Gold Barrel
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Gold barrel has 81 slots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lGold Barrel

allInOneQuestsList.name: GT6-Styled Wires and Cables
allInOneQuestsList.data:
They work basically the same as pipes, but you need wire cutters (or a soldering iron) instead of a wrench. Additionally, you take damage if they're not insulated (wire) but not if they are (cable).

Hint: If you click one wire or cable on the other it will auto-connect. Cables and pipes can be painted to make sure you do not cross your MV line with your EV line, or dump hot lava into your plastic water pipes. No boom today.

Ha ha just kidding there is always a boom today!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lGT6-Styled Wires and Cables

allInOneQuestsList.name: Gypsum
allInOneQuestsList.data: To make bricks for the blast furnace you need concrete and gypsum. Gypsum can be found in a vein together with basaltic and granitic mineral sand, and fullers earth. Y 50-60 and only in the overworld.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lGypsum

allInOneQuestsList.name: Hammer time v2
allInOneQuestsList.data: Using 6 ingots to craft a hammer seems pretty wasteful, as this tool has durability. How nice would it be to have a machine that does the same but without having durability and using three ingots to make two plates? Guess what, there is one! And you should totally get one.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lHammer time v2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Handpicking Crops is So Old School
allInOneQuestsList.data:
By making a scythe you are now able to clear 3x3 blocks of vegetation, and to harvest 5x5 tiles of crops! The harvesting ability works on most non-magical crops, including IC2 crops! Keep in mind this scythe will harvest IC2 crops even if they are not fully mature.

§6The quest should accept the tool whatever materials you used.
allInOneQuestsList.title: Handpicking Crops is So Old School
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Handpicking Crops is So Old School
Prequest requests:
Tool Forge

allInOneQuestsList.name: Hoppers
allInOneQuestsList.data: Hoppers come in handy when you want to automate your machines. You can input items via hoppers directly into GT pipes and you don't have to use a conveyor module. However, the input rate is much slower, and the hopper must be beneath its source inventory.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lHoppers

allInOneQuestsList.name: How Can I Carry All These Items?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
After you made your first steel, you are able to craft a small backpack. It has 36 slots, which is a bit more than a small chest. Later you can make it even larger.

You can have at most four of these backpacks in your inventory.

You can put one on your back and set it to automatically pick up stuff. In your controls, check that the command "Open Backpacks" has a key and doesn't have conflicts. The key only works after the backpack is added to the back slot, which can be done by using Shift+.
§r
You can rename your backpack by pressing Shift+RMB when holding it in your hand.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lHow Can I Carry All These Items?
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
How Can I Carry All These Items?
Prequest requests:
Blastoff!

allInOneQuestsList.name: How to Make Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Making rubber is now more complicated - you need raw rubber and sulfur. Finding a sulfur vein in the Nether seems like a good idea, doesn't it? Found on Y 5-20. Later on you can get sulfur from chemicals like hydrogen sulfide or pyrite.

[warn]Sphalerite will be important later for gallium and zinc. Save it until you can fully process it in LV.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lHow to Make Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
How to Make Rubber
Prequest requests:
Extracting Stuff
THE NETHER

allInOneQuestsList.name: How to open your Iron Doors?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Your iron doors make your Machine Hall or House more safe. They cannot be opened by hand.

Now let's craft some Pressure Plates and Buttons to open these heavy iron doors.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lHow to open your Iron Doors?
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
How to open your Iron Doors?
Prequest requests:
Factory Iron Door

allInOneQuestsList.name: I Ain't Afraid of no Ghost!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
I've found a use for the Ectoplasm you can collect from spirits of the dead. It makes a very useful glass that you can walk on, but mobs cannot. However, they think they can!

So you can use this to create a moat around your base that drops mobs to the death in various ways, or just to shuttle them off somewhere else. Separate babies from mothers? Use it in a mob farm? Capture pigmen walking into the Overworld from your Nether portal? So many possibilities!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lI Ain't Afraid of no Ghost!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
I Ain't Afraid of no Ghost!
Prequest requests:
A Clear View

allInOneQuestsList.name: I Know His Name!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Name Remover is a simple utility machine that can strip off incorrect or useless NBT data. Only works on GT items?

§3Was more useful before NBT disassembly data was removed, but good riddance I (and basically everyone) say.

Lead is plentiful in the Twilight Forest. Or if you are desperate, small ores can be found in the Nether.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lI Know His Name!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
I Know His Name!
Prequest requests:
Better Than Iron
Rubber Sheets

allInOneQuestsList.name: Iron Barrel
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Iron barrel has 54 slots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §2§lIron Barrel

allInOneQuestsList.name: It's a Dirty Job, and You're Going to Do It
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Plunger is used to clear liquids from pipes. It can also be used on a machine to remove up to 1000mb of fluid from its internal buffer. So you don't have to wrench your machine and re-place it. It can be crafted from a rod of the desired material and rubber sheets.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lIt's a Dirty Job, and You're Going to Do It
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
It's a Dirty Job, and You're Going to Do It
Prequest requests:
Rubber Sheets

allInOneQuestsList.name: Jacques Cousteau
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now that you have a Scuba Helmet you can safely explore underwater for long periods of time. You just need some compressed air cells. I'll trade you some Tin ingots for a few compressed air cells.

As your air drops, the helmet will take a compressed air cell and give back an empty cell. Throw these cells into your compressor and you can easily gather clay from beneath rivers. You'll be able to make more cells later once you get an extruder or a plate bender.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lJacques Cousteau

allInOneQuestsList.name: Key to Your Heart
allInOneQuestsList.data: Barrels by default allow locking the barrel to a specific item, even when empty. For drawers however you will need to make the Drawer Key to lock its content types.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lKey to Your Heart

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lapis, Lazurite, Sodalite, Calcite
allInOneQuestsList.data:
In order to make your bricked blast furnace you need to find a lapis vein containing calcite.

You can find the vein in the overworld at Y 20-50.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lLapis, Lazurite, Sodalite, Calcite

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lapis? Lucky!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Maybe you were lucky and received the luck modifier on your pickaxe. If not, you may still have an unused modifier on your pick so you can add some lapis lazuli. Or you can perhaps add another modifier by adding a diamond and a gold block to your pick and then add some lapis.

You can put the lapis lazuli in more than one slot in the tool station, use blocks to raise the luck level faster, and even use lapis blocks in the crafting station with your tool for maximum luck gain.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lLapis? Lucky!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lit Way to Get Charred
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The "Charcoal Pile Igniter" is an alternative option for mass-producing charcoal. It does not consume any power or steam, but generates a lot of pollution. Follow the steps below to get it working.

1. Build a brick floor no bigger than 11x11 in size.
2. Place 1-5 layers of logs atop the brick floor. No air gaps allowed.
3. Place the Charcoal Pile Igniter above the top-center log.
4. Surround the remaining logs in dirt or grass.
5. The Charcoal Pile Igniter immediately starts processing
6. After some time, the logs are converted to brittle charcoal blocks.
7. Break the blocks with an axe for the charcoal (Luck/Fortune has NO effect on the drop rates).

If this is your first multiblock, read the extended tooltip (hold shift) for construction requirements, or visit [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Charcoal_Pile_Igniter[/url] for more information and step-by-step images.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lLit Way to Get Charred
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Lit Way to Get Charred
Prequest requests:
Better Than Iron
Flint and Steel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lucifer's Little Helper
allInOneQuestsList.data:
With an alloy smelter and some netherrack dust you can make Nether furnaces, which are extremely efficient cooking machines. Very handy for someone needing a lot of stuff furnaced in a jiffy.

In comparison to the Blast Furnace, the only downside to crafting Nether Furnaces is that they cannot be used as a component for the Electric Blast Furnace (EBF) craft later on. Blast Furnaces can. Then again, Nether dust is practically free, so what's the loss? You can always use them to bake stacks of bread!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lLucifer's Little Helper

allInOneQuestsList.name: Macerator v1.0!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Finally you are able to make a device that will replace your mortar. However, the "no-durability" feature of this device comes with a cost: You need 2 diamonds for the grinding heads.

The macerator will double your ore output. Put ores through it instead of smelting directly.

§3NOTE: Remember, don't block the output port and don't stand behind it.§r
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lMacerator v1.0!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Macerator v1.0!
Prequest requests:
The Hell is That?
Making Better Tools

allInOneQuestsList.name: Making a List, Checking it Twice
allInOneQuestsList.data:
As your base grows, you're going to have a dozen different long term goals each with many steps. Build a clipboard to keep track of what you need to do.

[note]Hint: You can put the clipboard on a wall using shift-right-click.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lMaking a List, Checking it Twice
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Making a List, Checking it Twice
Prequest requests:
Compressing Stuff

allInOneQuestsList.name: Mining Dirt Block by Block is so Old School
allInOneQuestsList.data:
By making an excavator you are now able to mine dirt in a 3x3 area. You can use iron, steel, or obzinite poured from the Smeltery, it doesn't need to be steel.

Higher tier metals require the MV extruder. Don't destroy your whole garden.

§6The quest should accept the tool whatever materials you used.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lMining Dirt Block by Block is so Old School
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Mining Dirt Block by Block is so Old School
Prequest requests:
Tool Forge

allInOneQuestsList.name: Molds, Molds, Molds
allInOneQuestsList.data:
After you can make steel and have a tinkers smelter you can make molds. Molds can be used in the alloy smelter and the fluid solidifier. You need them to make vacuum tubes, ingots, gears and more.

[note]PS: The 'shapes' are for the Extruder.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lMolds, Molds, Molds

allInOneQuestsList.name: More Advanced Alloys
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Your smeltery does a great job mixing metals into alloys, but it's not very efficient, and limited in its complexity. You need something new, so why not put your steam to some use? The Alloy Smelter can make bronze for you directly, using ingots, dusts, or even nuggets. You can make a nugget mold as well to turn ingots into nuggets if you have steel.

It might also come in handy when processing raw rubber. You should keep an eye on recipes to see when machines offer better options to make items...

[note]NOTE: Like all steam machines, the output port is a steam outlet when recipes complete. It must not be blocked. Also, steam is hot, remember? Change the output side by whacking the machine with a wrench. The 3x3 grid will show you which side the output will move to when you whack it.[/note]

You can empty the machine by putting a hopper beneath it.

[warn]WARNING: The Alloy Smelter recipes take a lot of steam.[/warn] Do them one by one until you understand how fast you use steam, and how much you will need buffered. Large pipes are a decent "poor man's" buffer, and the boiler can hold quite a bit of steam, as well as the machine itself. Once you get a little further along, make a larger steam buffer with an iron or steel railcraft tank.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lMore Advanced Alloys
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
More Advanced Alloys
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 0.5, Steam!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Moving Your Tanks, Chests, and Barrels
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want to move your chests and barrels without spilling all the things (buildcraft™)? No problem! Make a dolly and you can carry your full chests, barrels or storage drawers anywhere you want. But be warned, you will get a slowness debuff so hopefully you don't have to travel very far. You can also move non-portable buildcraft and iron tanks without losing fluids, and worktables without losing stored recipes.

Shift-right-click an empty dolly to collapse it. It won't carry anything until you unfold it, but it will stack and can go in your backpack.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Multiblock Revolution
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The steam machines you have been using until now have served you well, but there will be a time when you need to process even more items. That's where the so-called multiblocks come in. There's a variety of steam multiblocks available to you - go have a look at the Mass Processing quest tab!

This tab introduces you to a wide range of extremely powerful multiblock machines that can replace your old, worn-out singleblocks (and some that can replace your old multiblocks!). Many of these new machines will require you to handle additional mechanics and requirements, but it will be worth it!

Here are some terms you should be familiar with as you enter the world of multiblocks:

Overclock (OC):
If a machine can handle at least 4 times the voltage that is required for a recipe, it will overclock - causing it to require 4x the EU/t but also run 2x as fast. This can happen multiple times!

Perfect Overclock (Often phrased as "Does not lose efficiency when overclocked):
Some machines conditionally (or unconditionally) perform perfect overclocks: in this case, the machine will require 4x the EU/t, but it will run 4x as fast instead, leading to both increased speed and no net increase in the total EU usage!

Parallel (Often phrased as "Processes x items"):
Machines which parallel act as if they are running multiple of themselves - that is to say, they are able to perform multiple of the same recipe at the same time, using the recipe's EU/t multiplied by the number of parallels. Machines which parallel will [warn]PRIORITIZE[/warn] this behavior over overclocking, which is good for you! Parallels are more efficient.

[note]When working with multiblocks, if power is interrupted during operation, your inputs will be lost forever... careful![/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lMultiblock Revolution

allInOneQuestsList.name: Safety First
allInOneQuestsList.data:
For those new to GregTech, here are some tips and warnings about electricity.

Machines don't like being out in the rain, and will start fires nearby. Fires next to a machine have a random chance of an explosion. Also, sending a higher voltage than a machine's tier causes an explosion. Or several, if you pack things together, like many people. Sending more amps than a machine can use doesn't harm anything though.

Sending too high a voltage or too many amps down a cable will cause the cable to burn up and start fires, which may then cause machine explosions. Make sure the number of amps provided by generators and buffers to a cable does not exceed the amps it is capable of carrying.

A generator that supplies 1A can possibly feed multiple machines, if their recipes require less than the full voltage. For example, macerators processing ore only need 2 EU/t, so you could run several from a single 1A generator, as long as the wires aren't too long. Why does that matter? Because there's loss for every amp for every block, listed on the wire/cable. Note that cables are better than wires. But be careful! Sometimes a recipe needs a lot more EU than you expect, like a macerator sand -> quartz dust recipe.

Most machines only use 1A, however there are exceptions, such as the arc furnace, thermal centrifuge, world accelerators, and the UUM machines. Note that machines can accept more amps than they use (usually 2) in order to top up their energy supply, especially if they didn't receive most of the amp because of loss (mostly a problem in LV). The formula is (EU/t of Recipe * 2) / Voltage Tier + 1. Keep this in mind when deciding on cables.

Some machines are specifically there to help you deal with multiple amps, such as battery buffers, transformers, and diodes. Check out the quest tab Storing and Transforming EU for more on those.

If you want to send more amps, use a larger cable or a superconductor (MV+, but ULV and LV have their own lossless cables). You can use laser hatches much later to send even more. There even are wireless options, but not right now.

A single block machine starved of EU will restart progress but not lose the recipe items. A multiblock machine will lose the items.

Note that any block that emits EU has loss when doing so: 2 ^ (tier-1) per amp. So 1 EU at LV, 2 EU at MV, and so on. Using large numbers of battery buffers in a row is thus very wasteful of your power. You have to be careful with losses when making your first EBF later in LV, maybe rather power them directly? Of course, if you want to keep your amps topped up over longer distances, you'll need to place BBs occasionally to 'top up' the amps, though this is less the case the further ingame you get, as the loss becomes less of something to worry about.

If this info isn't enough for you, head on over to [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Electricity[/url] to read more.

If you prefer to learn via video there are also great YouTube resources such as HamCorp's Electricity Guide: [url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lpDPY8J-4QY[/url]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lSafety First

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Rubber trees are not the only source for raw rubber. Go and find a slime island high in the sky. Slime balls and slime leaves give raw rubber too.
Make some slime tree farms beside your rubber farm.

allInOneQuestsList.data:
You've almost made it. One last crafting step is required in order to advance to Tier 1. Keep going!

This Steam Turbine generates electricity from Steam. The power source you've been using is the same, but from this point on you will generate EU, and bring it to your machines via cables, instead of bringing the Steam directly to them. Luckily, electric machines don't need an exhaust port, and they are considerably more efficient than Bronze machines.

At a later point, you will most likely switch from Steam to another fuel, though.

allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lSteel Chest?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tame an Ocelot to Get a Friend
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Once you have the required materials, you will need to find an ocelot to tame.

Ocelots can be found in Jungle Biomes.

If you are having trouble finding an ocelot, you can always summon an ocelot using a spawn egg.

You can tame an ocelot by giving it a raw fish. So add the raw fish to your inventory and select the raw fish in your hotbar.

Just like vanilla Minecraft, a tamed ocelot turns into a cat. The cat will repel creepers.

§3TIP: Make sure you are in a large space when trying to tame the ocelot so that the ocelot has lots of room to move. If you are in a space that is too small, you will not be able to tame the ocelot.

Next, while holding the raw fish, do not move. If you move, you will scare away the ocelot. If you are very still, the ocelot will eventually notice the fish in your hand and begin to walk over to you.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lTame an Ocelot to Get a Friend

Tame an Ocelot to Get a Friend

allInOneQuestsList.data: EFR adds with it vanilla Barrels (not to be confused with JABBA barrels). These are essentially like chests, but they can be placed next to each other and opened with a block above them. And you can upgrade them! Great for those compact machine setups.

allInOneQuestsList.data:
This is the first GT-type tank. It stores 32 buckets or 32,000L, and can be used to I/O cells. The ULV Tank from GT++ needs steel plates, iron plates, tin plates, a clay pipe, and a water bucket.

GT tanks do not auto-output. If you want to move fluids out of the tank, use a GT pump, conduit, or something similar.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lThe GT Tank, ULV Version

In order to get more machines, you'll need pistons. But not those amateurish ones, you need special ones, and I shall guide you in the making of them.

§3PS: Infernals can drop them, though you won't get credit for the quest that way.

allInOneQuestsList.name: The Iron Guy
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Do you feel lonely? Need some extra protection in your base? Want to keep the pigmen off your back in the Nether? Craft some Iron Golems and the monster problem inside your base will be gone.

They can do good amounts of damage and aggro enemies like the pigmen away from you. They can even take care of that pesky Vampire Pigman.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lThe Iron Guy

allInOneQuestsList.name: THE NETHER
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now more dangerous with extra hardcore infernal mobs. Have fun and take care. Remember that the flint and steel can take a few times to work, but there are other ways to make fire ...

Be sure to bring a tough companion along to keep you alive. If you have no friends, why not make an Iron Golem and push it through first, or bring the materials for more along with you?

Also, §lwhen§r you die here, not if, your graves will spawn skeletons because of the darkness. Make sure you light up areas where you might die, and when recovering graves light up the area §lfirst§r so that you don't end up dying over and over and making a mess.

Watch out for some mobs! They'll take minimal damage from any weapon that is not their weakness. So if you seem to not be doing much damage, you probably aren't! Think about other options to hurt/kill the monster.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lTHE NETHER

allInOneQuestsList.name: The one book to rule them all
allInOneQuestsList.data:
This Tome can store multiple documentation books from other mods. It will be empty when crafted, but you can add books by combining it with the desired book in a crafting grid.

Right-clicking with the Tome in hand will open an interface showing all the added books; clicking on a book will transform the tome into the selected book. To revert it back to the Tome, left-click while sneaking.

To retrieve a stored book, transform the Tome into the desired book and throw it away while sneaking - this will drop the selected book and leave the tome in your inventory.

[warn]Some warnings:

The extended version of the Book of Biomes from Witchery is not compatible with this tome.

You should not throw it through the Botania portal. The elves might steal your Tome and return only their own copy of the Lexica Botania.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lThe one book to rule them all

The one book to rule them all

allInOneQuestsList.data:
The sun has quite a bit of power, so why not use it to produce Steam?

Fill it with Water on the bottom side to produce Steam. Unlike the other Boilers, this only outputs Steam on the output port side.

You need Silver from small ores to craft Solar Boilers. Later in LV you can get much more in the Twilight Forest.

§3Hint: The Simple Solar Boiler calcifies and becomes less efficient over time, dropping down to a minimum of 40L/s. Later on you can consider using Distilled Water to avoid calcification.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Welcome to Tier 0.5, Steam!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Welcome, and well done so far! This tier is all about your first machines, getting more stuff from your ores and making bronze ingots in a more efficient manner.

For water, check out the Water Siding Tank multiblock in the Multiblock goals tab.

To connect up your boilers, be sure to provide water from the bottom, they'll accept only water from this side, so no risk of melting your pipe. Wooden pipes are fine for this. Make sure you never run out of water - [warn]adding water to a dry hot boiler will cause it to explode![/warn]

Steam will come out from the sides. Remember, steam is hot! It will destroy wooden pipes. And it can burn you if you walk on bronze pipes full of steam. Cover them with wooden planks or paper. Or just don't walk on/next to them.

And no, you can't automate it. Make an electric one if you want to do that.

Welcome to Tier 0.5, Steam!

This backpack sacrifices some space to give you a portable crafting table. You have to put the items you want to craft inside the backpack. Because of this, you can use it to quickly craft large amounts of items at once.

You can also use the Forestry Worktable with its larger inventory to do the same. Once you reach MV, you can switch to an Adventure Backpack that includes a pair of tanks for storing fluids if you want.

Your first tank that you can make would be a Buildcraft tank. This tank can carry up 16 buckets of a single fluid. It's possible to upgrade those tanks so they can hold up to 64 buckets.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Wire-Wrap
allInOneQuestsList.data: Placing wires without insulation seems to be a bad idea. Now that you have an extractor to extract raw rubber out of sticky resin and an alloy smelter to further process it using sulfur, you should work on getting some insulating rubber bars.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lWire-Wrap

allInOneQuestsList.name: Wooden Bolts
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Your crossbow need some ammo to shoot with. Let's craft some wooden bolts. For now, you can put either iron, obzinite, or steel on the tip of your bolts using the Smeltery. For higher tier bolts and tips you will need to pump metals into a Fluid Solidifier with the correct tool rod inserted.

[warn]For upgrades:[/warn]
[note]Nether Quartz - More damage
Moss - Self-Repair (unlock in GTNH Thaumcraft tab)[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lWooden Bolts

allInOneQuestsList.name: Wooden Crossbow
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now you are able to make a better long range weapon - a crossbow. Use wood for the crossbow limb and the body and use obsidian (Reinforced III) for the tough binding. Normal strings for the bowstrings would be enough for now.

Assemble the bow yourself on your tool forge.

[warn]For upgrades:[/warn]
[note]Redstone - Speed on the draw
Lapis - Fortune on kills
Moss - Self-repair[/note]

§6NOTE: Some mobs require damage from specific tools. IF YOU ARE SHOOTING AT SOMETHING AND IT IS NOT GETTING HURT, *RUN*. And then figure out what weapon might be best to kill it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lWooden Crossbow

allInOneQuestsList.name: Working Table 2.0
allInOneQuestsList.data:
A manual crafting table which remembers the last nine used recipes. Left-click one of the recipes shown in the right-hand side to automatically fill in the crafting grid. Right-click to lock a memorized recipe and prevent a newer recipe from bumping it off.

Resources need to go into the internal inventory. The crafting matrix is only a visual representation.

The Forestry worktable is super-useful, and can reduce the tedium of many common jobs because you can click-drag across a row of items, and it will use tools in its own inventory to continue crafting.

Specifically:
Making with - Put all the ingredients into the table, and if the recipe is selected, shift-click the result to craft them all at once (until you run out)
Making fresh water for Pam's - Same as above, but no second item
Making clay bricks - The wooden form is automatically reused
Making anything that uses a tool - Also automatically reused, while consuming durability

[warn]Warning: Stored recipes will be lost if the worktable is broken! To avoid this, move it using a dolly.[/warn]

[note]For more forestry quests you need to go to the dedicated tab.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: Working Table 2.0

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your First Electronic Circuit
allInOneQuestsList.data: Steam machines are quite stupid, they just do one thing over and over again. As you advance into the electrical age, you've decided that you want the machines to have more features, like automatic output in order to create some automation. For that, you need electronic circuits.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§lYour First Electronic Circuit
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Your First Electronic Circuit

allInOneQuestsList.data:
There are many tiers of upgrades for storage drawers. Make some iron and gold tier upgrades and I'll give you some of the special purpose upgrades to experiment with in your base. Check NEI for more options such as Obsidian, Emerald, and Diamond upgrades.

[warn]To remove upgrades, shift-right-click with an empty hand to access the drawer interface.[/warn]

allInOneQuestsList.data:

allInOneQuestsList.name: Analyzing the Soil
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tired of looking for ores by hand? Want to find underground oil that will last a long time? A seismic prospector will tell you the ores in the surrounding chunks in a (sorta) handy book you can read, and also the underground fluids beneath you. It doesn't need to be powered.

To determine which kind of fluid there is in the chunk you need to scan the soil by right-clicking an Advanced Seismic Prospector with 2 Powderbarrels, 4 Glyceryl Trinitate cells, 8 iTNT or 16 TNT. This one doesn't explode the user too on use. Features! There are four types of oil or natural gas for the overworld. See the quest in Tips and Tricks once you've made an oil drill.

1) Right-click explosives.
2) Use a single Data Stick to extract the data by right-clicking on it after the animation has finished. Each will hold ONE result.
3) Next you need to put the data stick in a GT scanner to have it analyzed.
4) Place the analyzed data stick in the bottom right slot of a printer and add 3 paper in the top left slot and make sure you have at least 144L squid ink in it.
5) Take the printed pages and combine it with a piece of leather in an assembling machine filled with at least 20 mb of refined glue.

[note]TADA![/note] Now you have a book with detailed info about the chunks you scanned. Visual Prospecting adds the information to your map the moment you make the book.

§2Data Sticks are not easy (or possible) to make right now, so do not lose them.§r You can put it in a crafting table to erase it when done.

Ore locations are given as the center of the chunk. Ores that are marginal in that chunk may not be found in the center but on an edge. Look at where ores are located and determine the center of the vein. At higher tiers, it scans more chunks for ores. If you just want to know about fluids, use the lower tier version so the book isn't as long.

Each underground fluid field is 8x8 chunks. This starts at 0,0 and continues for 8 chunks east and south, containing 64 chunks. Not all fields have anything in them though. Within the field the amount can vary +/- 25 percent. The amount reported in the book is the minimum and maximum per field across all chunks in the field. The prospector reports on 3x3 fields (as in, 9 fields of 8x8 chunks) at all tiers with the center field where the seismic prospector is located. Fluid extraction rate depends on many factors, check the wiki for details. In general, anything above 300 is really good. The total amount in the chunk is complicated.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lAnalyzing the Soil
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Analyzing the Soil
Prequest requests:
Scanning Bees, Crops and Moooooore!

allInOneQuestsList.name: A New Alloy - Cobalt Brass
allInOneQuestsList.data:
If you want to cut diamond blocks into plates, it's time to get a new alloy, Cobalt Brass.

First you need to make brass out of zinc (only found in small ores or TiCo Zinc Gavel Ore in the Overworld, in Nether Sphalerite, or as a centrifuge byproduct from tin or tetrahedrite) and copper. Mix it with tin and cobalt dust (you can get it as a byproduct of a couple ores, go searching in the nether, or go to the Twilight Forest for Cobaltite) to get the cobalt brass dust.

Now that you've come this far, we think that you're able to look up the ores that you need by yourself with the help of NEI.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lA New Alloy - Cobalt Brass
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A New Alloy - Cobalt Brass
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #1

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Wondering why you need magnalium now? It's not for GT machines but for a material update for your crossbow.

You already made some Aluminium dust before. Getting Aluminium will become easier once you get an EBF or MV electrolyzer.
If you can't find any aluminium, search for chests in the Twilight Forest or kill a few monsters.

Combine Aluminium and Magnesium in your alloy smelter to get Magnalium.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lA New Alloy - Magnalium
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A New Alloy - Magnalium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Antimony
allInOneQuestsList.data: The most efficient way to get antimony for batteries is to run stibnite through a BBF or EBF, burning off the impurities (sulfur), and giving you more antimony. You can also centrifuge it if you want to keep the sulfur. You can also centrifuge tetrahedrite dust if you're desperate.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lAntimony

allInOneQuestsList.name: Ardite and Cobalt
allInOneQuestsList.data:
If you have some time you can look for cobalt and ardite in the Nether.

You've heard rumors of a special wood only found in another land, a forest of Twilight, that can make tools strong enough to mine them.

Remember, you need an electric blast furnace to process these materials before you can make tools with them.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lArdite and Cobalt

allInOneQuestsList.name: Ardite Crossbow Body
allInOneQuestsList.data:
To make your crossbow even better, craft an ardite crossbow body. You received a few ardite ingots as reward before but will need to find ore in the Nether and process it in an Electric Blast Furnace.

With redstone you can make your bow faster. This requires a free modifier slot on your crossbow.

Don't bother putting Nether Quartz on the crossbow, it only improves damage from whacking mobs over the head with it. Put the Nether Quartz on your bolts instead.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lArdite Crossbow Body

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Truly Sharp Saw Blade
allInOneQuestsList.data: Combining cobalt brass and diamond dust makes a really sharp saw blade for your cutting machine.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lA Truly Sharp Saw Blade
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A Truly Sharp Saw Blade

A New Alloy - Cobalt Brass

allInOneQuestsList.name: Automated Crafting​
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Auto Workbench is a simple automated crafting system. You place ghost items in the grid to create the recipe, and place components in the inventory. They will slowly be converted into the crafted item. While not fast and can only do 1 recipe each, it does support automation - only items acceptable to the recipe are allowed in the inventory. It does not use power.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lAutomated Crafting
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Automated Crafting​

allInOneQuestsList.name: Automated Farmer
allInOneQuestsList.data: Your hoe must be getting worn out by now. Why not craft an electric one which never breaks?
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§l§d§5§lAutomated Farmer

allInOneQuestsList.name: Automated Sticky Resin Farmer
allInOneQuestsList.data:
If you're tired of crafting tons of tree taps, how about a machine that uses power but never breaks? Let's craft an electric tree tap!

(If you're looking for better ways to get Sticky Resin, you might want to consider the Stickreed crop from IC2 crops. To get it, plant Sugarcanes on Crops on an X formation, with spaces between them, and then put 2 Crops on each empty slot. For more information, check the crop quests.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§6§l§5§lAutomated Sticky Resin Farmer

allInOneQuestsList.name: Auto Mining
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Automatic mining in LV tier? Wow! This nifty machine will collect ores for you, which can be helpful especially in the Nether, as it won't anger pigmen.

Place up to two stacks of mining pipes in the right slots. Each pipe can go 1 block, and allow the miner to dig 1 block further. If you're above Y64, you may need to pipe more in.

This machine only needs 8 EU/t to work, so LV batteries in a batbuff work OK if you don't want to make another generator.

The miner searches for ores in a 17x17 block work area (adjustable with a screwdriver), and comes with a level 1 fortune bonus! Great for gathering additional small ores!

Don't forget to cover it up! These are GT machines, so remember to protect them (and their power sources!) from rain on all sides. And set a waypoint with JourneyMap so you don't forget where you placed it if you place it far away! You'll need to chunkload the miner if you want it to keep working when you're not there.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lAuto Mining

allInOneQuestsList.name: Avengers, Assemble!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
An absolute must have for fans of the movie. Oh, and to make all the things, of course. There are a number of recipes that take fewer materials to make in the assembler, or can only be made with it, so make it ASAP!

You can use the battery slot and the other extra slot in the GUI to store unused configuration circuits.

If you've completed the Silverwood quest on the first tab, you can go to the Twilight Forest after making your Assembler. See the Novice Thaumaturgy tab for details.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lAvengers, Assemble!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Arc Furnace
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The arc furnace is an alternative to macerating stuff back into dusts and for making wrought iron, annealed copper, and glass (in MV). You get ingots, and sometimes different materials back from recycling than with a macerator. You also have all 4 slots at LV. The recipes use oxygen and 3A of power.

Just ignore the plasma one.

And no, you can't just send 1A of MV. That will blow it up.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBasic Arc Furnace

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Canner
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The canning machine is used to fill batteries, fill cells with stuff (usually dust, not used that often), or to fill tin cans with any kind of food (HV+).

At LV-HV tier you can make batteries with sodium, cadmium, or lithium.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBasic Canner

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Circuit Assembler
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Advanced (HV) circuits require an LV circuit assembling machine. Basic (LV) and Good (MV) ones can also be made much more efficiently with this machine.

However, all circuit assemblers need higher tier circuits than the other machines of their tier. This means you have to use MV circuits instead of the LV ones you've been using until now. I know you want it, so make it already!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBasic Circuit Assembler

Basic Circuit Assembler

allInOneQuestsList.data:
To get your molten fluids back to a solid state you need a fluid solidifier. This is handy for processing molten rubber directly from the chemical reactor. It's used for crossbow bolts as well.

Keep in mind that GT fluids are different from Tinker's Construct. You will mainly work with GT fluids going forward.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBasic Fluid Solidifier

allInOneQuestsList.data: Monsters spawning in or near your base can be annoying. Especially if you happen to get infernal creepers. Luckily, there's a good way to prevent them from spawning at all.

Macerating ores usually doubles the output. If you want MOOOOOOORE, craft an ore washer and wash out some rare materials.

Note that these both use water, and are painfully slow.

Put crushed ore in them.

[note]You can also consider using the steam multiblock instead if you want.[/note]

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Mixing antimony and lead in the alloy smelter will give you battery alloy. Combine it with tin cable and voila, there's your small battery hull.

Small = LV, Medium = MV, Large = HV. It gets weirder after that.

Note that if you make the battery alloy in the mixer you need to use dusts, but if you use the alloy smelter you can use either.

Check out the quest tab Storing and Transforming EU for all details about EU power storage.

allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want to use all that delicious XP to raise your levels? Move the tank with XP above you and attach this convenient shower head to take the XP from the tank.

This thing can be laggy, so be careful about letting too many XP orbs out of the tank. Apply a redstone signal to turn it off.
