allInOneQuestsList.name: Better Gallium and Arsenic Sources
allInOneQuestsList.data:
There are a couple of ways to increase your Gallium.

1. Find TiCo zinc gravel ore and process it to get gallium.

2. Breed Zinc Bees and react the Gallium Combs with Hydrochloric Acid. The bee is not too deep in the breeding progression and the processing only requires LV.

3. Use IC2 crops under the Farming tab to get Galvania leaves, to 4x your zinc and sphalerite crushed ores to purified ores.

4. Use the HV macerator on the centrifuged ores to get a 10 percent chance of a whole Gallium dust.

5. Use plentiful Bauxite ores from the Moon.

6. Kill Redcaps/Redcap Sappers in Twilight Forest. Also Kobolds drop Arsenic.

7. Duplicate nugget with Thaumcraft. This requires §lTaboo§r researches, so you might not want to do this.

For Arsenic, Cobaltite ore in the Twilight Forest is a great source for more information go to the quest "Cobalt and Arsenic from Cobaltite".

Cobaltite can also be multiplied 4x by the IC2 crop Nickelback.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBetter Gallium and Arsenic Sources
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Better Gallium and Arsenic Sources
Prequest requests:
Gallium Arsenide Crystal

allInOneQuestsList.name: Biomes Everywhere, But Not the One You Want?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tired of searching all over the map for that Bamboo Forest or Tropical Rainforest? Desperate for clay dust and need to find a Canyon or Mesa biome? Nature's compass will lead you to the biome you're looking for, if it's within its range.

The compass menu has the following functionality:
* When Sorted By: Name, you can filter the list by name or its parts. The search is case-insensitive.
* You can search by keys and their combinations. For instance, name: bamboo, climate: warm, bh: -1.8, tag: forest.
All available keys are:
name,
climate [hellish, hot, warm, normal, cold, icy],
baseheight | bh (float, can be negative),
heightvariation | hv (float),
rainfall | rain (float),
temperature | temp (float),
humidity [damp, normal, arid],
tags.

Some things to keep in mind:
* Biomes from other dimensions show up on the list, don't bother searching for those unless you're in that dimension.
* In general, the full list has biomes that are not generated by Realistic World Generator, like Sunflower Plains.
* Radius 10000 means it couldn't find the biome. In this case after the initial search, its menu will show only the biomes in the 10k radius. Use Shift+RMB to see the whole list again.
* You can try again at a different location - the range is 10k from your current position.
* Artificially created biomes count, so remove them if you want to find a natural one.
* There's lots of different 'versions' of biomes under the same category, so if you want a tropical one for tropical bees, there are actually a bunch of places you can get it.
* For those who don't mind the freeze when searching, the radius can be changed in a config. The HUD position can also be changed in the config.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBiomes Everywhere, But Not the One You Want?
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Biomes Everywhere, But Not the One You Want?
Prequest requests:
Avengers, Assemble!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Black and Decker
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tired of having to replace tools all the time because they constantly break? Now that Steel is available, it's time to make some electric versions of the Screwdriver and Wrench! Charge them up like Batteries, and they'll last much longer than the non-electric versions of these tools.

You can use Lithium Batteries, or if you're on a budget, Cadmium or Sodium Batteries instead. This does reduce their energy capacity though. Later on, Vibrant Alloy will make excellent tools with great durability. There are, however, a multitude of other great materials that you may have access to, so take a look around in NEI and decide for yourself.

There are also MV and HV versions, though they require that you can process Aluminium or Stainless Steel, respectively.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §§§5§lBlack and Decker
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Black and Decker
Prequest requests:
Battery Alloy
Time to Get Some Steel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Brewing, the Industrial Way
allInOneQuestsList.data: If you want brews or alcohol, I recommend you to build one of these. You might have noticed that you cannot build a brewing stand without Thaumcraft. But fear not, you can still find them in secret rooms on the first floor of some roguelike dungeons or ur-ghast towers. Better get searching...
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBrewing, the Industrial Way
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Brewing, the Industrial Way
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Brittle But Hits Like a Sledgehammer...
allInOneQuestsList.data: A Carbon crossbow limb is 1/3 the durability of the magnalium limb, but hits a lot harder and shoots a little faster. But you'll want to carry around a tinker table and extra ingots to repair it constantly, and watch that you don't break it in the middle of combat!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lBrittle But Hits Like a Sledgehammer...
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Brittle But Hits Like a Sledgehammer...

Round and Round and Round...
Magnalium Crossbow

allInOneQuestsList.name: Butane and Propane
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You can crack and distill a lot of different fluids out of your already distilled products, such as Butane, Butene, Butadiene, Benzene, Ethane, Ethylene, Helium, Hydrogen, Methane, Octane, Propane, Propene, Toluene, and even more Light Fuel, Heavy Fuel, or Naphtha. You can then crack them down even further too sometimes. Many of these are only used for power. Go check out the spreadsheet for more details than this quest can encompass.

For now, get some Butane and Propane.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lButane and Propane
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Butane and Propane
Prequest requests:
Naphtha
Refinery Gas
Light Fuel
Heavy Fuel

allInOneQuestsList.name: C9H8O4...NaCl...H2O...
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want to make some cetane-boosted diesel, plastic or some chemical dyes? Then it's time to craft a chemical reactor.

You can use the battery slot and the other extra slot in the GUI to store items.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lC9H8O4...NaCl...H2O...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Cable Diodes
allInOneQuestsList.data: Sometimes you just need a Diode, either to prevent burning up cables when splitting off a main line, or on a Thermos Server's chunk borders. Make one 4A Diode and get a 2A one for free!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lCable Diodes

allInOneQuestsList.name: Cadmium
allInOneQuestsList.data: You can get Cadmium from Sphalerite (centrifuge or thermal centrifuge). Later on you can use GT++ Ore processing chains to get Cadmium from Rare Earths. I don't care how you get it, just get some Cadmium.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lCadmium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Cheaper Annealed Production
allInOneQuestsList.data: It's even faster and cheaper to make annealed copper in the arc furnace than in the electric blast furnace. Annealed copper is a very good material for cables in MV. It only loses 1 EU per block.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lCheaper Annealed Production

allInOneQuestsList.name: Chemical Bath
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Wait, what? You want more byproducts from your ores? A cheaper way to make paper? Well, the chemical bath is perfect for you!

You'll have to provide liquids like mercury to extract different products like nickel, silver, copper, and platinum (only as PMP) from ores.

For paper you'll only need some water and wood pulp. Maybe you'll find more uses for it!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lChemical Bath
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Chemical Bath
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #1
You're Gonna Hate This #2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Chemical Rubber Production
allInOneQuestsList.data: A much more efficient way to make insulated cables is by making molten rubber in a chemical reactor, which can be applied to a cable in the assembling machine. When you put both machines next to each other you can output the molten rubber directly to the assembling machine by clicking the fluid auto-output button on the chemical reactor. Make sure to set the correct side of the reactor as output side by wrenching it. Also remember to use the right circuit in the assembling machine.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lChemical Rubber Production

allInOneQuestsList.name: Chlorine, Your New Best Friend
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Chlorine is a fluid that is used in significant quantities throughout the game, so you might as well get used to collecting it now.

You can electrolyze Salt, Rock Salt, Sodalite (finally a use!), or Salt Water for it. Since you'll need so much, you may wish to consider using your first Super Tank to hold it all.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lChlorine, Your New Best Friend
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Chlorine, Your New Best Friend
Prequest requests:
How to Get Sodium and Lithium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Choices, Choices
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Need a map on fuel choices? Well, we don't have that, but we have suggestions. You can use Steam up to IV, but beyond MV it gets pretty painful.

In LV you can start refining oil for either Light Fuel for a Combustion Generator or Refinery Gas for a Gas Turbine. Or you can use Creosote in a Semi-Fluid Generator.

Once you hit MV, you can switch from Steam to renewable Benzene (Gas) from your logs. Other renewable alternatives are Fish Oil or Seed Oil based bio diesel (combustion). Seed Oil can be sourced from Pam's peanuts, IC2 Rape crop or Forestry tree nuts.

At MV you can also upgrade your Light Fuel with Heavy Fuel to get Diesel. When you reach HV turn diesel or bio diesel into Cetane Boosted Diesel. In EV, you can make High Octane Gasoline (HOG), but it's complex, and you'll need to rejigger your whole oil distillation setup, since it uses different fluids than Cetane does.

EV introduces the Large Gas Turbine, Large Steam Turbine, Large HP Steam Turbine, and Large Combustion Engine, which are more efficient versions of the earlier ones. The first 3 require turbines.

You can also make Nukes, or Wind and Water Kinetics.

For low-power operations, or dedicated players willing to set up autocrafting, you can begin using Solar Panels at MV.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lChoices, Choices

allInOneQuestsList.name: Circuit Programming
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Some machines have a very, very large number of recipes. To avoid conflicts, many recipes have programmed circuits to ensure that the correct recipe is used. These programmed circuits are not consumed.

In this modpack, all singleblock GT machines now come with an icon in the GUI on the bottom-right that represents a ghost circuit. Click it or scroll to choose the number you need. If you do that, you don't have to insert a physical circuit. This is going to be your main option for all single block machines. This option is now also available for input buses of multiblocks, which you will use much later.

There are a few places throughout the modpack where you still need the physical circuits. You can turn an LV circuit into a programmed circuit in the crafting grid and then program it in various ways:

1) Find a correct crafting recipe with a screwdriver in NEI and use that.

2) Right-click while holding the programmed circuit to open an easy menu. You still need to at least have the screwdriver in your inventory though or it won't work. Eventually you can also make an electric screwdriver.

3) Use the BartWorks Circuit Programmer. It's only available in MV, but it does not use any durability and runs on EU.

4) Use the GT++ Circuit Programmer block. It isn't portable and only available in MV, but it allows for automation.


The tasks in this quest are just the showcase of what programming circuits there are. You can just click the checkmark once you understand how the programmed circuits work.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lCircuit Programming

You can make it with your EBF now using Cobaltite Ore from the Twilight Forest and Oxygen to get Cobalt. It's a little complicated, but you also get arsenic out of it.

You can also just electrolyze it out in MV, which is what you §oshould§r be doing instead of this, but assuming you actually need it this method has higher yields (at the cost of carbon of course).

allInOneQuestsList.name: Diamond Spikes
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Diamond Spikes damages mobs (or you!) that touch any side of it other than the bottom. With 7 attack damage, the Spike does as much damage as a Diamond Sword. Mobs will not walk around the block, but will try to walk over it as if it were a regular solid block. Most explosions won't destroy the Spike because it has a very high blast resistance.

These can also be enchanted with all the enchantments a regular diamond sword would receive. This includes Looting and Sharpness, which function exactly as it does on a sword. Interestingly, mobs killed by the Diamond Spike will return experience as if killed by the player.

There are weaker versions, but who wants that? If you happen to want the last hit, you might want the wooden ones though.

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Good circuits need diodes. There are two main ways to craft them. You can crush the Gallium Arsenide crystals to dust and combine that with fine copper wires and molten glass. Once you have solar grade silicon you can use it to make silicon wafers in your EBF to make even more. Note that the wafers are much more efficient on gallium and arsenic, so even a reduced amount is still worth it.

Make sure you check all the NEI recipes for advanced items instead of just using the first one you find. You can use annealed copper wires and polyethylene to increase your output even more.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Enderman Smelterman
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Need enderpearls? Getting them by killing endermen can be dangerous. Instead of doing that, put an enderman into a smeltery with hot fluids and use a gem cast to get guaranteed pearls.

The higher the hit points, the longer they'll last, so the more pearls you get. If you can find a regenerating enderman, or an enderman spawner, you'll have all the pearls you would ever want. Later on with EnderIO you can even create your own powered spawner to make endermen on-demand. Or just place it in the End and move the mobs inside.

Use a nametag on a regenerating enderman to make sure he doesn't despawn. You'll want to keep him from seeing the sky or else he'll teleport away.

If you haven't found a regen enderman yet, you can buy enderman spawn eggs to put into your smeltery with coins. Maybe you'll get lucky and get a regenerating one.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lEnderman Smelterman

allInOneQuestsList.name: Exploding Fluids For Power
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Combustion Generator produces EU from several fluids and spends fuel only when necessary. Some fluids are more popular than others, but the Oil processing line has a different combustion fluid in every tier from LV to EV, and all of them are burned in these generators.

To start, LV is the tier of Light Fuel. It is worth much more than the Oil itself for generating power, so you should distill and desulfurize the Oil to get clean Light Fuel and use it for power. It's a great way to run your base, and can be upgraded further in the next tiers. Check the "Working with Oil" tab for more information, once you've made a Pump and found some Oil.

If you're dealing with Oil processing, this is the type of generator you'll use the most.§r

allInOneQuestsList.name: Firestone Ore/Dust
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Firestone ore is used to make some BC machines like the filler, and some other stuff. Unfortunately, it's in the nether...at the bottom of the lava ocean!

Here are some tips for finding it:

-Firestone only spawns in deep lava, at least 6 deep. It will only replace netherrack, so a fjord filled with soulsand won't have any. Can you think of ways to check the lava depth, and what's down there?
-Alternatively, if you keep your head at just the correct height above the lava and at the correct angle, you'll be able to see underneath it - surely there must be a hovering jetpack?
-...or just look for the biome when your cursor is over the JM map. Hell is the default one that has netherrack.

Firestone can be mined with the GT miners, if you place it within horizontal range. Firestone ore and products will cause random fires to start nearby, so get it into a backpack quickly!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lFirestone Ore/Dust

allInOneQuestsList.name: Fluid Canner
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The fluid canner used to be the main way to fill cells, single-use batteries, and coolant cells. It was needed because direct interaction with cells was limited.

Now everything is much easier and cells almost always work as expected, so you likely won't need this, even for molten redstone.

However, if you want an electric hoe or treetap, you'll need to make IC2 batteries in a fluid canner.

Another interesting thing about this is it also works as a fluid uncanner. And maybe later you could fill a Lighter with it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lFluid Canner

allInOneQuestsList.name: Gallium Arsenide Crystal
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The diode requires gallium arsenide, and you may be wondering how to get gallium or arsenic this early in the game.

Sphalerite and zinc are the primary sources of gallium at this tier.

You can find sphalerite in sulfur veins at Y 5-20, and the small zinc ores in the Overworld or the Nether at Y 80-210. You won't find much on the Overworld because of obvious reasons. To get additional zinc crushed ore drops, use a Tinker's Construct tool with the Luck (Fortune) enchant on it, probably the best use for all that lapis you got while looking for calcite. Or use a miner, if you don't mind how slow it is.

- Sphalerite can be electrolyzed for a small chance of a gallium dust. Better put in a lot or you might get unlucky.
- Zinc crushed ore can be washed and then thermal centrifuged or forge hammered and then centrifuged. But you don't always get the crushed ore as a drop, the impure dust doesn't give gallium.

You can get arsenic from realgar small ores in the Nether at Y 15-85. Centrifuge the dusts in a centrifuge.

Other sources are Tinker's Construct cobalt ore in the nether and cobaltite ore in the Twilight Forest. You can use your EBF for that. You also need to level up your pickaxe to ardite or make an Ironwood Pickaxe or LV Miner to harvest cobalt ore.

Another way to get gallium and arsenic is with XP buckets in a crafting grid if you're really desperate.

With your EBF you can combine these two dusts to make a Gallium Arsenide Crystal.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lGallium Arsenide Crystal

allInOneQuestsList.name: Getting Ready for Tier 2, MV
allInOneQuestsList.data:
In order to proceed forward, you need to get aluminium. A lot of it. But for now, 8 is enough to complete this quest.

Your first option is alumina dust. Probably the best source for alumina is clay or hardened clay from canyons, however you need an MV machine for that, so you need to find an alternative until you have enough dust for your initial setup. For now, you can get it by centrifuging various impure piles from your ores or by smelting ruby, sapphire, or green sapphire in an EBF with carbon. Check the EBF quest in the Multiblock Goals.

You will also need an EBF to turn the alumina into aluminium ingots. For that you need cryolite. Go visit the Twilight Forest for that and find a Cryolite vein. The related quest is "Lead, Galena, Silver and Cryolite" is the Novice Thaumaturgy tab.

Your second option is to use aluminium dust. However, you can not smelt that directly yet, even if you have an EBF. That will require higher heat levels. For now, you will have to either use a Tinker's Smeltery or a GT Compressor to turn the dust into raw aluminium which you can then smelt into ingots in the EBF.

By the time you've completed this, you'll probably be done with most of the tab, but you'll still need Good Circuits (MV) to actually open up the next tier if you haven't done that yet.

You might also want to check the Getting Around and Without Dying tabs for new unlocks.

[note]If you were exploring Twilight Forest before 2.1.1.4 you won't find any cryolite in existing veins. You'll need to explore new chunks.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lGetting Ready for Tier 2, MV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Handle Tiny Piles Like a K1ng
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Don't you hate having to manually compress all those tiny piles? Well, let me show you how to automate that. A combination of type filter, chest buffer (or super buffer in HV) and packager frees you from that annoying task. The chest buffer can hold up to 9 stacks of tiny piles and the super buffer can hold 256 stacks of tiny dusts, which is more than enough. You can set its mode with a screwdriver on the output side. Set it to 9 to export 9 tiny piles at a time and let the packager compress these into regular dusts.

Super buffers can be lag sources, so be careful to keep them as empty as possible. If you're using a multiblock packager, be sure to change the buffer from Stocking mode to Transfer Size mode.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Heavy Fuel
allInOneQuestsList.data:
By adding Hydrogen to sulfuric Heavy Fuel in a Chemical Reactor you can produce Heavy Fuel, with a burn value of 360,000 EU per cell! Aside from this, it's also required for Diesel, in MV, which is a better fuel, and it can also be distilled into three very useful fluids: Benzene, Toluene and Phenol.

If you want to use Heavy Fuel as a power source, you will need Semi-Fluid generators, unlike Light Fuel and Diesel which use Combustion generators.

It's honestly not especially efficient to make Heavy Fuel out of regular Oil. You should try to get Heavy Oil to make it, like from Oilsands Ore in MV once you can. Then use it to make Diesel.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Hello Baron, How's Your Black Gold Today?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
During your travels you may have seen some huge oil spouts. Now's the time to make a pump and go collect this black gold into tanks. Oil can be burned directly in a combustion generator (onsite to power the pump, perhaps?) or be refined for better fuels and crafting materials.

Bring a generator or battery buffer (with full batteries obviously) with you to power the pump. Thanks to the advancement of technology the pump can auto output on top. Stacking multiple pumps makes them work faster. In that case, oil has to be removed from the bottom of the stack using a pump cover or other means like a conduit.

Taller spouts have more oil. But for the LV pump, it's better to use the short spouts if possible since it doesn't have enough range to fully collect the larger ones in the horizontal range. Save the taller spouts for MV or HV pumps.

Mining pipes are needed for pumping the oil, same as the auto miner. When it hits the bottom (or something in the way), if there's no fluid left to collect, it will start retracting the pipes. Same thing if you disable it with a soft mallet. You can also change the range with a screwdriver if there's a reason to do that, like collecting lava in a limited area faster.

These are GT machines, so remember to protect them (and their power sources!) from rain on all sides. And set a waypoint with JourneyMaps so you don't forget where you placed it!

[note]Once you run out of surface oil, you'll want to turn to:
1) Oilsands ore, though this is better suited for making heavy oil
2) Making oil from logs in a pyrolyze oven
4) Bacterial Vat (EV+)
5) Crops
6) Bees
7) Underground (UG) oil. Dimensions generally have a couple fluids that can be accessed with a multiblock version of the pump, available in MV+[/note]

[note]Heavy oil cannot be used until MV for anything except lubricant and burning in semifluid generator since it requires MV distillery.[/note]

allInOneQuestsList.name: Here's Some Oil
allInOneQuestsList.data:
[note]Here the oil questlines diverge into two tabs - part about getting every possible output is in the LV tab, part about the usefulness of oil is in the Working with Oil tab, this quest is part of the latter.[/note]

Welcome! This is the questline that shows the path through oil processing towards all the useful items and fluids that can be obtained from it. Working with this black liquid involves a lot of steps that range from LV (Low Voltage), all the way to IV (Insane Voltage), and outputs that are useful at those tiers and beyond.

Oil is useful both for generating power, and to automate a lot of chemicals that are important for progression. As you progress, you will be able to get more of it, and get it faster, as well as process it in new ways that improve on the setup that you were using before. It is not a required path for progression in the pack, but it is a very useful one, should you choose to follow it.

The best way to start working with oil is to extract it from the surface. Oil spouts are visible without having to dig down, and they can be interacted with by using a Pump placed above them, alongside a generator that feeds it some power. You can use some of the Oil to generate this power for now.

allInOneQuestsList.data:
The mixer is a very useful device. You can mix all kinds of fluids and items. Useful to prevent dust from falling to the ground when crafting - most mixer recipes give a slight boost over hand crafting!

You get +3 slots in the EV+ versions, this one has 6.

You can use the battery slot and other extra slots in the GUI to store anything you like!

[note]You can also consider using the steam multiblock instead if you want.[/note]

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Centrifuge some brown or yellow limonite dust, or use an Electrolyzer with water to get some hydrogen.

There are many other ways of obtaining hydrogen which you might want to look into. Some are only available much later.

Examples are: chemical processing or electrolysis of methane obtained from organic sources, electrolysis of water or salt water, mixing sodium with water, or eventually siphoning hydrogen directly from a gas giant.

allInOneQuestsList.data:
A second source for sodium is glauconite ore or glauconite sand. This type of ore vein can be found at Y level 20-50.

Soapstone and talc can be used for lubricant.

allInOneQuestsList.name: How to Get Sodium and Lithium
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Salt ore mixes can be found in the Overworld between Y 50-70.

Salt isn't only used to get sodium, it's an important ingredient in many pam's harvestcraft food recipes.

Lepidolite and spodumene are good sources of lithium for your batteries. Later on you can get a lot more in different ways.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Hydrogen, Methane or Some Farts... (Natural gas)
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Some centrifugal processes leave gases behind like Hydrogen or Methane. Centrifuge some Brown and Yellow Limonite to get Hydrogen or dump your unused food in a Centrifuge to get Methane gas. Wood will even give 60 mb per log, and many other crops will also generate Methane this way.

The main powergen line that uses this generator is Benzene, but that needs MV tier.

If you're dealing with fully renewable powergen, this is the type of generator you'll use the most.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lHydrogen, Methane or Some Farts... (Natural gas)
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Hydrogen, Methane or Some Farts... (Natural gas)

You're Gonna Hate This #3

allInOneQuestsList.data: A few recipes require IC2 batteries. Fill your small battery hull with some molten redstone and you'll get an RE-Battery.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lIC2 Battery

allInOneQuestsList.name: I Guess it's an Inkjet?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
When you use the seismic prospector, you'll need a scanner and a printer to create the books full of tasty ores and delicious fluids.

Use ink sacs in a fluid extractor to get squid ink. Then move it using pipes or cells.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lI Guess it's an Inkjet?

I Guess it's an Inkjet?

Analyzing the Soil

allInOneQuestsList.name: Keeping things organized
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Are you tired of storing Shapes and/or Molds near your Extruders and Solidifiers instead of inside them? Today must be your lucky day, because these item holders let you do exactly that!

They allow your machines to hold a small number of extra items, though each slot can only store one item at a time. There are three versions of this cover, each offering a different amount of storage:

Basic Item Holder: 9 slots
Good Item Holder: 12 slots
Advanced Item Holder: 15 slots

[note]If that's still not enough space and you are already using the highest tier, you can simply attach multiple holders to your machine of choice.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lKeeping things organized

allInOneQuestsList.name: Light Fuel
allInOneQuestsList.data:
By adding Hydrogen to Sulfuric Light Fuel in a Chemical Reactor you can produce Light Fuel with the very high burn value of 305,000 EU per cell. It is also the main component of Diesel, an excellent fuel that becomes available in MV

The remaining Hydrogen Sulfide can be used to produce Sulfuric Acid for, well, tons of stuff. You can never have enough of it! You can also crack Light Fuel in a Chemical Reactor and then distill it to get Ethylene, for Polyethylene. But Refinery Gas is better for that.

Light Fuel

allInOneQuestsList.data: Lithium can be washed out of Lepidolite Ore or centrifuged out of either Lepidolite Ore or Spodumene Ore. At MV you can electrolyze clay dust for it. Look for canyons to find hardened clay and macerate it for dust.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Long Distance Fluid Pipeline
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Wouldn't it be great if you could transport your oil from a far away oil spout or oil field by pipes to your base?

This is not a problem anymore. Connect your setup on the start and end point with a Long Distance Fluid Pipeline block. In between use the associated pipe blocks - the total distance between endpoints must be more than 64 blocks apart (4 or more chunks). There can only be one start and end point per pipeline.

To actually connect it, you need to align the start LDFP block such that the arrows are facing inwards, and the opposite side of it has a LDFPP block. Put a pump on the side of the block that has the arrows and set to import. It will now attempt to import fluid to the endpoint LDFP. §2This will go as fast as you can put fluid into it.§r

Do the opposite on the far side, except you don't need a pump.

Now you only need to chunkload the start and end points and the fluid will be "teleported" to you.

Of course, later on you'll probably use ender tanks to §oactually§r teleport the fluid, especially from other dims.

This setup is lag-free in the pipe blocks, so it's useful in your base as well if you want to reduce lag.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLong Distance Fluid Pipeline
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Long Distance Fluid Pipeline
Prequest requests:
Hello Baron, How's Your Black Gold Today?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Long Distance Item Pipeline
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Wouldn't it be great if you could transport ores from a far away ore vein by pipes to your base?

This is not a problem anymore. Connect your setup on the start and end point with a Long Distance Item Pipeline block. In between use the associated pipe blocks - the total distance between endpoints must be more than 64 blocks apart (4 or more chunks). There can only be one start and end point per pipeline.

To actually connect it, you need to align the start LDIP block such that the arrows are facing inwards, and the opposite side of it has a LDIPP block. Put a conveyor on the side of the block that has the arrows and set to import. It will now attempt to import stuff to the endpoint LDIP. This will go as fast as you can put items into it.§r

Do the opposite on the far side, except you don't need a conveyor.

Now you only need to chunkload the start and end points and the items will be "teleported" to you.

Of course, later on you'll probably use ender chests to §oactually§r teleport the ore, especially from other dims.

This setup is lag-free in the pipe blocks, so it's useful in your base as well if you want to reduce lag.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLong Distance Item Pipeline

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lossless LV Cables
allInOneQuestsList.data:
How about lossless 32 EU cables? Redstone alloy is a superconductor and will transfer your energy without any loss.

Redstone Alloy is a new alloy which requires an EBF. Mix redstone, silicon and coal by hand, or in the mixer for a better result.

[note]Remember not to mix it up with Red Alloy, that's the ULV one.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLossless LV Cables

allInOneQuestsList.name: LPG
allInOneQuestsList.data: Centrifuging Butane or Propane gives you LPG with a burn value of 320,000 EU.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLPG

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lubricant​
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Using lubricant instead of water or distilled water in your cutting machines will increase their speed.

You can make lubricant out of oil, seed oil, fish oil or creosote in a distillery (or distillation tower later on). If you're able to craft a brewery you can use talc or soapstone to get much more lubricant each cycle.

Lube cells are required to make low tier energy hatches, so stockpile a few cells and use the rest to make your cutting machine faster.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLubricant
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Lubricant​

Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!
Brewing, the Industrial Way

allInOneQuestsList.name: LV Advanced Steam Boiler
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The LV GT++ Steam Boiler is the next machine you can build to produce steam more efficiently than with the previous single block boilers. It won't use fuel unless it cools below 100 degrees and gains a higher efficiency with longer burning fuels.

[note]Fortunately, it won't explode if you let it run dry but it §nwill waste fuel§r if there is no water present.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLV Advanced Steam Boiler
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
LV Advanced Steam Boiler
Prequest requests:
A Lead About Lead That Leads to Lead

allInOneQuestsList.name: LV Extruder
allInOneQuestsList.data: The extruder is not very useful in LV. But it will extrude your next tier of boat, make rubber sheets more efficiently, get you extra fluid cells, or make §osome§r Tinkers Construct tool parts.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lLV Extruder

allInOneQuestsList.name: Machine Interface Fluid I/O
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Thanks to the tireless work of the devs, you can now use cells to I/O fluids directly from the interface of GT machines. Just click on the fluid while holding a cell or other fluid container item.

Points to consider:
1) Left-click to attempt filling/emptying all fluid containers held on cursor.
2) Right-click to attempt filling/emptying one fluid container held on cursor.
3) All fluid containers that can be used in a standard gt tank (e.g. super tanks or the X voltage tanks) are supported, including but not limited to: water bottles, vanilla buckets, ic2 (universal and normal) cells, volumetric flasks, large fluid cells, pressurized fluid tanks, etc.
4) Can fill/take less than one cell (1000L or 144L if molten) of fluid if the fluid container supports doing so.
5) It won't check if it's a valid fluid for the machine/recipe, keep that in mind.
6) Doesn't work with Crops++ alcohols, feel free to code compatibility for us.
7) EIO tanks need to be placed and picked up first before they can be used.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMachine Interface Fluid I/O
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Machine Interface Fluid I/O
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 1, LV

allInOneQuestsList.data: It's time to craft a Crossbow Limb and the Crossbow Body to upgrade your old Wooden Crossbow.

allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Magnalium Crossbow

allInOneQuestsList.name: Magnalium Crossbow Bolts
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Magnalium bolts are much better than your old wooden bolts.

You can use nether quartz on the bolts to make them even better. This requires a free modifier slot.

Experiment with NEI to find other good bolt materials.

To make these bolts, you must use a Fluid Solidifier instead of the Tinker's casting table. It's important that you get the molten iron out of the smeltery and into the Fluid Solidifier, the GT molten iron won't work.

The bolts should be in your inventory if you want to pick up the ones you fired. You can't pick them up if the bolts are in Battlegear slots.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMagnalium Crossbow Bolts
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Magnalium Crossbow Bolts

Basic Fluid Solidifier

allInOneQuestsList.name: Magnesium Source
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Magnesite, the source of Magnesium can be found in the Twilight Forest at Y 10-40. Fullers Earth can be found on the Overworld at Y 50-70. Marble dust is a great source of Magnesium too.
Other options in LV are Pyrope, Olivine, or Ashes.

§3You only need one of the three to complete the quest.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMagnesium Source
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Magnesium Source

Round and Round and Round...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Magnetize Your Rods
allInOneQuestsList.data: Magnetic steel rods will §oneed§r a Polarizer to craft. You'll need them later on for MV Motors and MV hatches.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMagnetize Your Rods

allInOneQuestsList.name: Magnets != Magic
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tired of running after ore or other blocks? Use a magnet! It has a limited range, but who cares? Just remember to turn it on.

In HV you can craft it into the better one, if you still need a magnet by then.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMagnets != Magic

allInOneQuestsList.name: Mercury
allInOneQuestsList.data: Mercury can be centrifuged out of redstone. If you find some cinnabar ore in a redstone vein or one of the infused stone veins you can use that too.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMercury

allInOneQuestsList.name: Methane
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Distilling some "refinery gases" gives you some methane gas. There are many more (and probably better) ways to get methane.

You will need this in later tiers, for PTFE as an example.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMethane

allInOneQuestsList.name: Mica Ore
allInOneQuestsList.data: Mica is a very rare but useful ore. You need it in order to craft your coils for the Electric Blast Furnace. Only for cupronickel coils there is a replacement recipe. If you have no luck in finding this vein yet try to look for it with a Prospector once you get them.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMica Ore

allInOneQuestsList.name: Mjolnir!!!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Not really required, but it is a lot faster than the steam one and it can be automated. If you feel like ore washing is too slow, use this hammer.

[note]You can also consider using the steam multiblock instead if you want.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMjolnir!!!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Molten Redstone?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You heard that the carpenter needs some molten redstone for a few recipes. Converting redstone dust into a fluid requires a fluid extractor. Let's build one.

If you want to get that molten redstone into a cell, you'll need a fluid canner instead of a GT tank. Why? Because Reasons.

Fortunately, most fluids work properly, but redstone, cracked fluids, and certain other ones do not. Or just use a universal cell.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lMolten Redstone?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Naphtha
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You can process Sulfuric Naphtha to fluid Naphtha which has a burn value of 220,000 EU in the Gas Turbine. Naphtha can be used to get Ethylene for Polyethylene, but it shares this use with Refinery Gas and Light Fuel, so decide for yourself which one you want to use.

If you choose to make High-Octane Gasoline in EV and onwards, it will need a lot of Naphtha. You can also make Polycaprolactam (Nylon), which doesn't have any useful purpose yet, but it might get some in the near future.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lNaphtha
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Naphtha

C9H8O4...NaCl...H2O...
Sulfuric Naphtha

allInOneQuestsList.name: N Like Nitrogen... Hide, the Alphabet Strikes Again!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You can get some nitrogen by centrifuging... air. This process takes a long time, especially at LV tier.

You get that air from compressed air cells, which are gotten from running cells through a compressor. Each one contains 2000L, unlike a normal cell that contains 1000L.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lN Like Nitrogen... Hide, the Alphabet Strikes Again!

N Like Nitrogen... Hide, the Alphabet Strikes Again!

Round and Round and Round...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Node Upgrades
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Nodes can take many upgrades. For now, try building a World Interaction Upgrade. With it, you can set up simple autocrafting.

Put a WIU in a transfer node attached to a crafting table. On the other side of the table, the 3x3 area is now treated as a crafting grid. Place items in inventories on the other side and if they make a valid recipe, the WIU will craft it. To speed it up, you will need to wait until HV for stainless steel.

Also, if you place a node on a block of cobble that has lava and water next to it, and a WIU in it, it will produce cobble for you automatically. Use upgrades to get more at a time and faster.

[warn]The WIU can NOT be used for infinite water in GTNH.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lNode Upgrades

allInOneQuestsList.name: No More Filing
allInOneQuestsList.data: Why waste a full ingot to make a rod by using a tool which loses durability and takes even MORE ingots? With this little device, all your rod-needs shall be fulfilled (for now at least, the MV Extruder is the next step for rods).
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lNo More Filing
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
No More Filing
Prequest requests:
Saving Metal With Bending

allInOneQuestsList.name: Oilsand, or How You Get Heavy Oil
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Oilsand is another way to get heavy oil. Maybe you got lucky and found some in a mountainous biome. With your centrifuge you're able to get heavy oil and sand out of the ore. The veins can be found between Y 50-80.

Sadly, you can't use heavy oil until MV, so just stick them in a barrel or something until then.

[note]Until MV it can only be used for lubricant and burning in a semifluid generator.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lOilsand, or How You Get Heavy Oil
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Oilsand, or How You Get Heavy Oil
Prequest requests:
Round and Round and Round...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Personal Chunkloading
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Let's craft a personal chunkloader. It will load a 3x3 chunk area. You need ender fragments, ender pearls, or coins to power the chunkloader.

Personal anchors can be powered with ender fragments for 1h, ender pearls for 4 hours, and a varying amount depending on the coin used.

Personal Anchors§r are loaded once the owner visits, and stays loaded while the player is logged in.

Passive Anchors§r are loaded once the owner visits, and stays loaded until the server resets.

World Anchors§r are always loaded, even after a server reset.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lPersonal Chunkloading

allInOneQuestsList.name: Portable Mob Spawners...? Cool!
allInOneQuestsList.data: Do you want to move a spawner around and build a cool mob farm? That will be no problem if you get the diamond dolly. You can move 6 spawners before the durability runs out, which is probably more than you'll need right now.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lPortable Mob Spawners...? Cool!

Portable Mob Spawners...? Cool!

allInOneQuestsList.data:
How about large steel fluid cells instead? Each holds 8000L, and they can stack to 64. Unfortunately, you have to load and unload them using a machine's interface - like ULV tanks for example - but hey, 512 buckets in a single slot is pretty good!

You cannot use these cells directly in the world, like BC tanks, or to dump the fluid on the ground.

Portable Tanks Too Small?

allInOneQuestsList.data: The Precision Laser Engraver does not have many functions in LV, but is needed to create Cut Firestone which can later be filled with lava.

allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:

allInOneQuestsList.data:
With the basic forming press you can make different food items, glass arrows and some Project Red components.

At MV/HV stage you can make rotors, various AE components and make copies of your molds and extruder shapes.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Prison Gangs are Obsolete
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want lots of cobble, stone, obsidian, or another type of rock? This is the machine for you!

§lCobble:§r Water and lava on the side.
§lStone:§r Water on the side, lava on top.
§lObsidian:§r Lava on top or side, Water on side, and redstone in the machine.
§lNetherrack:§r Lava on top or side, Water on side, and glowstone in the machine.
§lBasalt:§r Lava on side, soul sand below, and one packed ice in the machine.
§lCobbled Deepslate:§r Lava on side, soul sand below, and one magma block in the machine.

You of course need to power it. If you don't want to spend power on cobble, do it the ExU way with the WIU.

You need to toggle the ghost circuit to circuit 1 or 6 depending on the recipe, check NEI.

allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:

You're Gonna Hate This #3

allInOneQuestsList.data: For the emitter and the sensor you'll need to get some certus quartz.

Welcome to Tier 1, LV
Quartzite Veins

allInOneQuestsList.name: Quartzite Veins
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Nether is full of different kinds of quartz. Go and find a quartzite vein. They're located between Y 80-120. It might be hard to find one, because that area is usually air, you'll just have to keep looking.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lQuartzite Veins

allInOneQuestsList.name: Refined Firestone
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Cut Firestone is the basic shape for producing Refined Firestone.
Use a Diamond Lens or Flint Lens for cutting.
It is then fired with lava in the EBF.

Lastly it is thrown into lava and charged by absorbing lava blocks around it.
It needs 5000 lava blocks to be fully charged, so a large lava lake is required, preferably in the Nether.

[note]If the firestone breaks, it can be repaired with lava in the EBF and recharged.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lRefined Firestone§5

allInOneQuestsList.name: Refinery Gas
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Refine your gas in a chemical reactor with Hydrogen gas to give it a better burn value of 160,000 EU. It used to be the least useful fraction of oil, but it's now possible to distill it into large amounts of Ethylene if you steam-crack the Refinery Gas beforehand.

This early, you will have to use a Chemical Reactor to crack it, but later on there's a dedicated multiblock for this purpose, the Oil Cracker. For best Ethylene results, you should severely steam-crack it, and you will get lots of Methane as well.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lRefinery Gas
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Refinery Gas
Prequest requests:
Sulfuric Gas
H for Hydrogen... the Rest of the Alphabet is Too Complicated...
C9H8O4...NaCl...H2O...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Round and Round and Round...
allInOneQuestsList.data:
After purification of your ore dust, you can centrifuge it to get even more byproducts out of the dust. On top of that, you can process many items into their more useful byproducts with this machine, such as Sticky Resin and Brick Dust.

It's always useful to check NEI for Centrifuge and Electrolyzer recipes for any item/fluid you may need. It might just be that you can get that from stuff you already have in your base!

[note]Use the checkbox if you rather use the steam multiblock.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lRound and Round and Round...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Saving Metal With Bending
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Instead of a 3:2 ratio of ingots to plates, this machine allows for 1:1. This saves an enormous amount of metal, so make it ASAP.

BTW if you want foils, just run the plate back through. There are other circuit modes, but you can discover them later.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSaving Metal With Bending
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Saving Metal With Bending

You're Gonna Hate This #3

allInOneQuestsList.name: Saving Redstone
allInOneQuestsList.data: Tired of using 4 redstone for 1 magnetic iron rod? Well, good news for you! The polarizer doesn't need redstone, just a little bit of power. You don't need to attach this machine to a permanent power source, it runs fine on battery power, since it uses so little.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSaving Redstone

allInOneQuestsList.name: Scanning Bees, Crops and Moooooore!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Automate your bee, sapling, or crop scanning. For crops, this is the only real way to find the crop's stats until you can craft the Portable Scanner, which needs HV circuits that you can make in the next tier.

Later on, this machine gets very useful for scanning high tier machine parts for the assembly line research data or to fill data orbs with data for UU-Matter production. Data sticks with raw prospecting data need a scanner too.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lScanning Bees, Crops and Moooooore!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Scanning Bees, Crops and Moooooore!
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #5
You're Gonna Hate This #6
Good Circuits

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sifting Machine
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Do you need flawless or exquisite diamonds, emeralds, rubies or other gems? Or, interested in getting more flint, coal, or whatnot out of your ore? Well then it's time for you to make a Sifting Machine.

You can find small Zinc ores (look in NEI) or you can search the Nether for Sphalerite.

The Sifter only takes Purified ores, but you can get these easily by throwing Crushed ores into a Cauldron with water.

[note]Note that you need Polyethylene to make this machine![/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSifting Machine

allInOneQuestsList.name: Simple Ore Washer
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Too lazy to make an ore washer, yet bored with your non-automatable cauldron? Then the simple washer is the machine for you! It works much faster than a normal ore washer. Of course, you don't get any byproducts, but who cares!

There are simple washers for every tier up to UV, but the speed doesn't increase much past the HV version.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSimple Ore Washer
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Simple Ore Washer
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sodium
allInOneQuestsList.data: Sodium can be washed out of Glauconite Ore and Sand. It can also be electrolyzed out of salt.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSodium
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Sodium
Prequest requests:
How to Get Sodium
How to Get Sodium and Lithium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Suction Device... Nice
allInOneQuestsList.data:
I hope you're not thinking about what I'm thinking you're thinking about...

It's highly recommended to get one of these, as the efficiency in terms of coal/steam used to extracting something is a lot better when using EU.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §3§5§lSuction Device... Nice
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Suction Device... Nice
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sulfuric Acid
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Combining sulfur trioxide and water in the chemical reactor will give you sulfuric acid for your single use acid batteries. You'll need to make sulfur dioxide first.

On the other hand if you've made some light fuel you'll have some spare hydrogen sulfide you can also turn into sulfuric acid (after a couple steps), and if you've automated it, you'll be drowning in it honestly. Once you can make an LCR, you can skip directly from HS to SA in one step. Keep in mind that you'll need all that acid for making stuff instead of for single use batteries by then.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSulfuric Acid

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sulfuric Gas
allInOneQuestsList.data: Another distillate for your gas turbine you can make out of oil is sulfuric gas with a burn value of 25,000 EU per cell.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSulfuric Gas
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Sulfuric Gas
Prequest requests:
Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sulfuric Naphtha
allInOneQuestsList.data: Another distillate you can make out of oil is sulfuric naphtha with a burn value of 40,000 EU per cell in the gas turbine.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lSulfuric Naphtha
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Sulfuric Naphtha
Prequest requests:
Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tetrahedrite, Stibnite and Copper
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Maybe you're wondering why you need tetrahedrite or stibnite. Well, antimony can be centrifuged out of it which is very useful for batteries. Batteries store power, so you can have highs and lows in your power production while still outputting stable power.

The veins can be found between Y level 80-120.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lTetrahedrite, Stibnite and Copper
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Tetrahedrite, Stibnite and Copper
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 1, LV
THE NETHER

allInOneQuestsList.name: Thermal Centrifuge
allInOneQuestsList.data:
A machine to get different byproducts out of your crushed or purified ore dust. It's useful for getting a bit of Gallium out of crushed Zinc Ore for your Diodes needed in good circuits.

When you have IC2 nuclear reactors and want to recycle your depleted fuel rods, it's the only way to do so.

If you can't produce the 2A of LV power for this machine right now, wait until you get to MV and use transformers to power an LV version.

In LV, you can obtain the same ore byproducts via different methods. The Thermal Centrifuge only becomes really important in HV when you can combine it with the HV macerator.

[warn]Sending MV power to an LV device, even if it uses more than 1A will cause an explosion, so don't do that.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lThermal Centrifuge

allInOneQuestsList.name: Throwing Out the Trash
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Already have barrels full of cobblestone? The voiding drop filter can be set up to automatically void any item on pickup. Cobble, dirt, arrows, saplings, etc. It's handy for when you don't have much room for junk.

To use, right-click the item filter you get as a reward. Put the things you want voided in the item filter list by clicking in there with them. Esc, then right-click the voiding drop filter, and put the item filter inside.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lThrowing Out the Trash

allInOneQuestsList.name: Time to Dry Out the Nether
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Pumps can do more than pump oil and water. You can go to the nether and pump lava from the huge lava lakes too.

Once you reach HV, lava can be centrifuged for Silicon Dioxide, Magnesia, Quicklime, Gold, Sapphire, and Tantalite. You can get Silicon, Magnesium, Calcium, Gold, Aluminium, Manganese, Tantalum, and Oxygen out of them.

This is a good use for your LV pumps once you upgrade to MV pumps for oil. If you get into Thaumcraft or Blood Magic, there are ways to produce lava with magic unlimitedly and easily too.

[note]You'll want either ULV tanks and cells, or BC tanks and a dolly to transport your lava.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lTime to Dry Out the Nether
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Time to Dry Out the Nether
Prequest requests:
Moving Your Tanks, Chests, and Barrels
Hello Baron, How's Your Black Gold Today?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Too Much Fluid??
allInOneQuestsList.data: Impossible! If you really think you have so much fluid that you want to just get rid of it, make a fluid trashcan. You can route as much excess creosote or whatever into it that you want.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lToo Much Fluid??

allInOneQuestsList.name: Vroooooom...
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tired of standing around to collect all the drops and XP from your diamond spikes?

Make yourself a vacuum hopper to suck up all the drops and XP. Feed the XP into a tank to store it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lVroooooom...

allInOneQuestsList.name: Welcome to Tier 1, LV
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Why, hello there! It seems you've made it into the electrical age. Don't be so quick to throw away your steam machines, you'll probably want to keep using them for a while.

To make your life easier, you'll want to focus on getting a wiremill and bender first... once you suffer through making all the machine components.

After that, the polarizer, assembler, lathe, and chemical reactor+fluid solidifier (for rubber) all help make things cheaper.

LV machines are more energy-efficient than their steam counterparts because steam machines convert Steam to Power with 50% efficiency, when the starting LV Steam Turbine has 85% efficiency.

ULV doesn't exist.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§r§5§lWelcome to Tier 1, LV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Where Does it All Go?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The time may come when you finally decide you have enough of a fluid. This overflow cover lets you tune how full a tank can get. You can put it on a smaller tank leading to a bigger tank, and when the bigger tank gets full, the fluid will backup into the smaller tank. Once the fluid level in the smaller tank exceeds the setting on the cover, it will start voiding fluid.

Handy for an oxygen centrifuge setup when you don't want to stop from excess nitrogen.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lWhere Does it All Go?
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Where Does it All Go?
Prequest requests:
Avengers, Assemble!

allInOneQuestsList.name: You're Gonna Hate This #1
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The first item you'll need a lot of. If you want to pull items out of chests or barrels you'll need one.

It works well with item pipes or GT machines, adjust with a screwdriver.

You can access the cover's interface with Shift+RMB.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #1
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #1
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 1, LV

allInOneQuestsList.name: You're Gonna Hate This #4
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The fourth item you'll need a lot of, and is also a pain to craft. The most painful item you need to make lots of.

It works like a conveyor but can work with selected item slots, adjust with a screwdriver.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #4
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #4
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This #3

allInOneQuestsList.name: You're Gonna Hate This #2
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The second item you'll need a lot of. When you want to get fluid out of tanks you'll need one.

Attach it to fluid pipes or GT machines/blocks. Adjust the flow direction and redstone behavior with a screwdriver. Place it on the side facing the tank or machine. When looking at a pipe or machine, you can use the grid to place it on a side already touching another thing. You can use the grid with a screwdriver to adjust a cover on that side as well.

When a GT pipe or machine has any cover, including a pump cover, wrenching the machine back into an item keeps the cover on that machine. The cover stays with the machine in the same direction when it is placed down again. This way you can arrange pump and conveyor covers on a machine outside a tight spot and place it there. To remove covers, use the crowbar.

It can also be further upgraded into a fluid regulator that allows precise control of fluid transfer speed.

You can access covers interface with Shift+RMB.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #2
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #2
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 1, LV

allInOneQuestsList.name: You're Gonna Hate This #3
allInOneQuestsList.data: A piston, but more... "electrical". The third item you're going to craft a lot of in the future.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #3
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #3
Prequest requests:
Welcome to Tier 1, LV

allInOneQuestsList.name: You're Gonna Hate This #6
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The sixth item you'll need a lot of. For the scanner and the seismic prospector.

[note]BTW, there's technically one more, the Field Generator, but you need higher tier circuits to make it, and it isn't used as often until later tiers.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #6
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #6
Prequest requests:
Process Some Certus Quartz

allInOneQuestsList.name: You're Gonna Hate This #5
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The fifth item you'll need a lot of. For the microwave, the scanner, the precision laser engraver, etc.

The Emitter and Sensor aren't used as much as the other items, fortunately.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYou're Gonna Hate This #5
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
You're Gonna Hate This #5
Prequest requests:
Process Some Certus Quartz

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your Magic Progression
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now that you're able to produce Aluminium, you may dig into magic. If you haven't unlocked basic thaumaturgy, try to find a Silverwood and a Greatwood sapling.

There is a coin quest that lets you purchase these saplings. If you haven't found any yet, go check it out!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYour Magic Progression
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Your Magic Progression
Prequest requests:
Getting Ready for Tier 2, MV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Burning oil in the combustion generator is a very inefficient way of producing power. Every bucket/cell of oil only gives you 20,000 EU. Time to refine it.

You'll need to use a circuit to pick which of the products you want. Later on you can make a Distillation Tower to get all of them, but that's far away for now.

You can also distill many other fluids! There are two that are useful, but take a long time to distill, so you should set them up in advance:
Lubricant (from Creosote) and Distilled Water (from Water).
allInOneQuestsList.title: §5§lYour Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Your Oil is Too Crude? Refine it!
Prequest requests:
Hello Baron, How's Your Black Gold Today?
You're Gonna Hate This #2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Acetic Acid
allInOneQuestsList.data: Acetic acid can be made out of Oxygen and Ethylene. Alternatively, it can be made out of Biomass, Wood Vinegar or Vinegar. It is an important part of making Ethenone on your way to Cetane-Boosted Diesel.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAcetic Acid

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Centrifuge
allInOneQuestsList.data: The MV centrifuge is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAdvanced Centrifuge

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Circuits
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Finally, the HV circuit! To make it, you need good integrated circuits, RAM, an integrated logic circuit, and transistors.

By the way, circuits get cheaper to make as you go along, but not till HV.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAdvanced Circuits

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Compressor
allInOneQuestsList.data: The MV compressor is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAdvanced Compressor

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Fluid Extractor
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The MV fluid extractor is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.

To make bio diesel you need seed oil or fish oil. Seeds give seed oil and fish produce fish oil when placed in a fluid extractor.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAdvanced Fluid Extractor

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Macerator
allInOneQuestsList.data: The MV macerator is twice as fast as the LV one but uses 4x the power.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAdvanced Macerator

allInOneQuestsList.name: All the Crops You Could Want
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Tired of applying bone meal or fertilizer by hand? A sprinkler can take water and boost your crop growth rate. Bone meal or fertilizer will make it work even faster.

[note]Note that the sprinkler does not work with IC2 crops.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAll the Crops You Could Want
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
All the Crops You Could Want
Prequest requests:
Come to the Dark Side...

allInOneQuestsList.name: All Those Chunks, All in a Row
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Sometimes you don't want a 3x3 area chunkloaded, but a long straight line instead. This can be handy for rail lines or power lines going across long distances. An anchor sentinel can perform this function. Right-click on a chunk loader with a crowbar, and it will activate. Go in any straight line from the chunkloader and place the anchor and hit it with the crowbar. Those chunks, up to 25x1, will now remain loaded.

This will draw an amount of chunkloader time relative to the 9 chunk area normally loaded. If for some reason you wanted only a 1 chunk area loaded, this will extend the time. Stock up on those pearls or server coins!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAll Those Chunks, All in a Row
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
All Those Chunks, All in a Row
Prequest requests:
Passive Chunkloading

allInOneQuestsList.name: All We Are is Dust in the Wind
allInOneQuestsList.data: Looking for an alternative to flowing water for your mobfarm? Use a fan to blow mobs or items where you want. Apply a redstone signal to activate.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAll We Are is Dust in the Wind
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
All We Are is Dust in the Wind
Prequest requests:
MV Motor

allInOneQuestsList.name: A New Alloy, Soularium
allInOneQuestsList.data: There are some... "Darker" uses for machines. Stuff that might be considered "magic". Anyway, for that you need a new alloy: Soularium.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lA New Alloy, Soularium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Are You Prepared For HV?
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Stainless steel will be the tier material for HV. Use an MV mixer to produce the dust.

Manganese can be acquired as ore byproducts from spessartine, pyrolusite and tantalite ore. You can also pull them apart to get even more. Alternatively you can take apart Red Garnet dusts. If you get desperate, you can buy some ore from the Coins tab.

Chrome can be electrolyzed out of ruby dust. You can get ruby dust from redstone if the ruby in redstone veins isn't enough.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAre You Prepared For HV?
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Are You Prepared For HV?
Prequest requests:
Mixing at MV level

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Soul Vessel
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Soul Vial is used later in HV Ender IO machines. For now though you may find it convenient to deal with....troublesome mobs. The Soul Vial is reusable. Just right-click any living entity to steal its soul. Right-click again to release it in the environment.

The possibilities swirl in your head...
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lA Soul Vessel
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
A Soul Vessel
Prequest requests:
A New Alloy, Soularium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Auto Mining MV
allInOneQuestsList.data: The MV miner will find ores for you faster than the LV miner, and in a larger range. It also has a larger fortune bonus, great for gathering small ores in the Nether. Plus it's faster, but I'm sure you figured that.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAuto Mining MV
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Auto Mining MV

You're Gonna Hate This in MV Too #3
You're Gonna Hate This in MV Too #6

allInOneQuestsList.data: Time to make the MV version of the assembler.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lAvengers, Assemble! 2
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Avengers, Assemble! 2

You're Gonna Hate This in MV Too #4

allInOneQuestsList.name: BEEEP BEEEP BEEEP
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Knowing that your cleanroom needs maintenance is pretty important. Instead of just turning on a light, why not use a howler alarm? It'll notify you up to 128 blocks away.

[warn]Warning: May cause uncontrollable urine leakage when activated.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §6§lBEEEP BEEEP BEEEP
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
BEEEP BEEEP BEEEP
