allInOneQuestsList.data: Field Generators are powerful devices. They're generally used in super tanks, super chests, in UU-Matter production and use, or in teleporters. Also, anything someone wanted to make harder to make.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lLV Field Generator
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
LV Field Generator
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 1-4 in HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: LV Microprocessor
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Microprocessor is the highest tier version of the LV circuit, getting you 2 per recipe.

In addition to what's listed, you'll need 2 Resistors, Transistors, and Capacitors, SMD or non-SMD.

This advanced circuit type needs a cleanroom.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lLV Microprocessor
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
LV Microprocessor
Prequest requests:
Advanced Circuit Assembler
Empty Plastic Board
Cleanroom

allInOneQuestsList.name: Magnetic Personality
allInOneQuestsList.data: If you haven't received one in a lootbag already, you can craft a nice magnet with a vibrant crystal. It doesn't work great on servers if you're moving around too fast, but it makes harvesting crops a lot easier.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lMagnetic Personality

allInOneQuestsList.name: Mainframes, Your First IV Circuit
allInOneQuestsList.data: Mainframes are the first IV Circuits you can make. It's used for a few EV machines, and basically all IV machines and components.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lMainframes, Your First IV Circuit
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Mainframes, Your First IV Circuit
Prequest requests:
Advanced Circuit Assembler II

allInOneQuestsList.name: Mixing at HV Level
allInOneQuestsList.data: Mixing better alloys needs a better Mixer.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lMixing at HV Level

allInOneQuestsList.name: NaK
allInOneQuestsList.data: Let's make some NaK coolant!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNaK

allInOneQuestsList.name: Need a Place For All Those Ores?
allInOneQuestsList.data: ...at last, the final chest, it will keep its inventory even after breaking! Item transportation will become much simpler with this!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNeed a Place For All Those Ores?
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Need a Place For All Those Ores?
Prequest requests:
Auto Mining HV
Obsidian Chest
Dark Steel Chest

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nitric Acid
allInOneQuestsList.data: Nitric acid can be made out of water, oxygen and nitrogen dioxide.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNitric Acid

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nitric Oxide
allInOneQuestsList.data: To make nitric oxide you need to combine oxygen and ammonia in a chemical reactor.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNitric Oxide

allInOneQuestsList.name: NITRO! (Cetane-Boosted Diesel)
allInOneQuestsList.data:
1,000,000 EU per cell, way more dense than before. Yes, yes, this is very good! Make some cetane-boosted diesel fuel and power your Combustion Engine with it.

[note]BTW HOG is a different path, so you'll need to completely redo your setup if you want that in EV.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNITRO! (Cetane-Boosted Diesel)

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nitrogen Dioxide
allInOneQuestsList.data: To make nitrogen dioxide you need to combine oxygen gas and nitric oxide in a chemical reactor.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNitrogen Dioxide

allInOneQuestsList.name: NOR and NAND Chips
allInOneQuestsList.data: NAND is used for data sticks, data orbs, and UV circuits. NOR chips are needed for data orbs and LuV circuits. You can get these by cutting NAND and NOR wafers. Just worry about the data sticks for now.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lNOR and NAND Chips
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
NOR and NAND Chips
Prequest requests:
Precision is Required
HV Cutting Machine
Phosphorus Doped Wafer
Cleanroom

allInOneQuestsList.name: Performing Chemical Experiments at HV Level
allInOneQuestsList.data: High tier chemical recipes like ammonia need an HV chemical reactor.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPerforming Chemical Experiments at HV Level
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Performing Chemical Experiments at HV Level
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 1-4 in HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Petri Dishes, Not for Eating
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You'll need petri dishes to hold the cultures. You can make them out of borosilicate, styrene, or PTFE.

The petri dishes must then be sterilized to allow cultures to grow on them. You can use ethanol, methanol, ammonia, or chlorine to sterilize them.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPetri Dishes, Not for Eating
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Petri Dishes, Not for Eating
Prequest requests:
Bio Lab

allInOneQuestsList.name: Phosphorus Doped Monocrystalline Silicon
allInOneQuestsList.data:
To make more advanced wafers, you need to make phosphorus doped monocrystalline silicon first. The process takes a while, so make sure you have stable power.

You can also get more wafers, and thus more chips out of higher tier boules. You still need to make the lower tier ones sometimes though.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPhosphorus Doped Monocrystalline Silicon
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Phosphorus Doped Monocrystalline Silicon
Prequest requests:
Tier 3 (HV)
Silicon Solar Grade
More Heat - Kanthal Coil Upgrade

allInOneQuestsList.name: Phosphorus Doped Wafer
allInOneQuestsList.data: To create some phosphorus doped silicon wafers, cut them in a cutting machine. An HV version of the cutting machine is needed for future wafers and chips.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPhosphorus Doped Wafer
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Phosphorus Doped Wafer
Prequest requests:
Phosphorus Doped Monocrystalline Silicon
Cleanroom

allInOneQuestsList.name: Playing With Dust
allInOneQuestsList.data: This machine will help you turn dust into crystals which you will need for high tier recipes.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPlaying With Dust
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Playing With Dust
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 1-4 in HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Polydimethylsiloxane Dust
allInOneQuestsList.data: Put Dimethyldichlorosilane and Water into the chemical reactor to get Polydimethylsiloxane.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPolydimethylsiloxane Dust

allInOneQuestsList.name: Polystyrene
allInOneQuestsList.data:
To make Polystyrene use the chemical reactor to combine oxygen and styrene.

[note]There's only one type of machine that uses it, so don't bother making more until you need it.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPolystyrene

allInOneQuestsList.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Molten plastics smell great, don't they? Mix your Hydrofluoric Acid and Chloroform to make Tetrafluoroethylene. React the TFE with oxygen to make molten PTFE.

[note]To get the 125 sheets without any leftovers or anything missing, follow the amounts of the optional quest and use the recipe that uses 1000L of Tetrafluoroethylene and 7000L of Oxygen. [/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPolytetrafluoroethylene

allInOneQuestsList.name: Precision is Required
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You'll use this a lot to make high tier circuits, and for other recipes.

[note]You'll soon find that everything you use the PLE on needs a cleanroom, so make sure you start on that.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPrecision is Required
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Precision is Required
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 5 and 6 in HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Processor Assembly
allInOneQuestsList.data: This is the second step to making EV and IV circuits.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lProcessor Assembly

allInOneQuestsList.name: Prototype Matter Manipulator
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The §4§lMatter Manipulator§r is an extremely powerful tool that you can use during your entire playthrough. It is essentially a survival version of world-edit that is custom made for the GTNH player's convenience.

The §3§lPrototype Matter Manipulator§r is expectedly the least powerful, most rudimentary version. You can only use the §5§lGeometry Mode§r to create and manipulate shapes for use in building. You will §nnot§r be able to remove blocks until you install an upgrade unlocked in §2§lEV§r.

For the most accurate and detailed information visit: [url]https://github.com/RecursivePineapple/MatterManipulator/blob/master/README.md[/url]

[note]The best way to learn about it is to use it! Experiment with the UI and become familiar with how it works.[/note]

[warn]Checkout the Building Better Bases tab for the complete Manipulator questline.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lPrototype Matter Manipulator
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Prototype Matter Manipulator
Prequest requests:
Tier 3 (HV)
You're Gonna Hate This 5 and 6 in HV
LV Field Generator

allInOneQuestsList.name: Raw Styrene-Butadiene Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.data: The second last step is Raw Styrene-Butadiene Rubber. Mix Butadiene, Styrene and Oxygen to make the dust.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lRaw Styrene-Butadiene Rubber

allInOneQuestsList.name: Recycle for the Environment
allInOneQuestsList.data:
If you have too much wood, saplings, netherrack or other garbage, you can recycle it and get scrap [note](this does not have a 100% chance)[/note]. Scrap can be used to make UU-Amplifier to make UU-Matter in 1/4 the time, saving you a significant amount of energy.

Certain items such as cobblestone, stone, and tiny/small dusts are too easy to make and don't give any scrap. But otherwise any items can be recycled to get scrap.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lRecycle for the Environment
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Recycle for the Environment
Prequest requests:
Workstations, Your First EV Circuit

allInOneQuestsList.name: RF Solar Panel
allInOneQuestsList.data: It's possible to power RF machines with a solar panel. It outputs 10 RF/t. Perfect for low use RF machines.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lRF Solar Panel
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
RF Solar Panel
Prequest requests:
Power of the Sun
Vibrant Alloy

allInOneQuestsList.name: RF Solar Panel Tier 2
allInOneQuestsList.data: The upgraded RF solar panel is much better. It outputs 40 RF/t.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lRF Solar Panel Tier 2
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
RF Solar Panel Tier 2
Prequest requests:
RF Solar Panel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Rock Cutter LV
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Rock Cutter is an unbreakable and Silk-touched Mining Device. It will enable you to mine blocks without damaging them, like glass or stone, while it is charged. Uh, Woo?
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lRock Cutter LV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Rotor
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Kinetic Wind and Water Generators need Gearbox Rotors to function. They can be added and removed with standard automation. Higher tier rotors will last longer. In addition, the iridium ones don't break. The IC2 ones might bug out for durability loss though. Energetic is probably the best for now, since it can give out a full amp, and more is wasted.

[note]You only need to make one rotor to complete this quest.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §c§9§lRotor
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Rotor
Prequest requests:
Kinetic Wind Power HV
Kinetic Water Power HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Rutile
allInOneQuestsList.data:
You've gotten some Rutile as a byproduct by now, right? Or EBF'd some Ilmenite?

Rutile, Chlorine and Carbon makes Titaniumtetrachloride, and some CO. You can recycle this for Carbon if you want to. Best use a Large Chemical Reactor in that case to get the full recipe.

Combining TiCl4 with Magnesium in an HV EBF will give you a Hot Titanium ingot, and Magnesiumchloride. You can recycle this as well to get all the Magnesium and Chlorine back using some Sodium.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lRutile

allInOneQuestsList.name: Sending the Power Back
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Kinetic generator compatibility has been improved so that you no longer need transformers, you can connect directly with a cable. But why not use your transformer to send the power back to base more efficiently, it's a loss of about 57/512EU per A just going from 160 straight down to 63 without it. If you transform up (after going through 1 block of cable to transform it to GT power), you only lose about 57/2048EU per A, much better.

[warn]IC2 machines don't care about rain, but remember to cover your transformer.[/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSending the Power Back

allInOneQuestsList.name: Separating Gems From the Dust
allInOneQuestsList.data: The sifter runs sooo slow, you should make an HV sifter to get gems faster.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSeparating Gems From the Dust
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Separating Gems From the Dust
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 1-4 in HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Separating Molecules
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Many centrifuging recipes are slow. You better upgrade your machines.

There are many interesting things you can centrifuge outside your normal ore processing or Methane production. Glowstone, Redstone, Soul Sand, Lava, Ashes, Planet Dusts, Compressed Air, etc. Make sure to look around a bit.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSeparating Molecules

allInOneQuestsList.name: Shake That Booty...
allInOneQuestsList.data:
...out of the purified ores. Anyways, a Large Sifter will increase your sifting speed significantly. What will you do with all these gems??

[note]You need one more casing if you don't want to use 2 energy hatches.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lShake That Booty...
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Shake That Booty...
Prequest requests:
Separating Gems From the Dust
High Voltage Multiblocks

allInOneQuestsList.name: Silicone Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want to make the synthetic rubber Silicone? As the first step you need Chloromethane.

You can use 2 Chlorine and 1 Methane per Chloromethane in your chemical reactor. Alternatively you can use Methanol and Hydrochloric Acid.

There are different ways to do it and this quest is only an example of how you can make it.

§6Already automated Silicone Rubber? Hold 128 sheets to skip this questline.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSilicone Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Silicone Rubber
Prequest requests:
Performing Chemical Experiments at HV Level

allInOneQuestsList.name: Silicone Rubber Sheet
allInOneQuestsList.data: Lastly we add a bit of sulfur to the polydimethylsiloxane dust and get molten silicone rubber.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSilicone Rubber Sheet

allInOneQuestsList.name: Simple SoC - System on a Chip
allInOneQuestsList.data: SoCs (Systems on a Chip) are used to simplify circuit crafting. In this case, you can use Simple SoCs to make ULV circuits more easily.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSimple SoC - System on a Chip
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Simple SoC - System on a Chip
Prequest requests:
Advanced Circuit Assembler

allInOneQuestsList.name: Small Coil
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Processor Assembly circuit needs some small coils. You can make these a couple different ways.

[note]If you're an overachiever and created SMD Inductors already you may hold 24 in your hand to skip this quest.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSmall Coil

allInOneQuestsList.name: SMD Circuit Components
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Surface-mount devices are more advanced circuit parts. They're needed for circuits starting next tier and are cheaper to craft than basic capacitors, transistors, diodes and resistors. Once you get a reliable polyethylene setup, you can save a lot of resources by using SMD components.

Be sure to check how much gallium you have available. It might not be worth it to use SMD diodes and transistors until you have a steady supply with an HV macerator or bees. Also look into IC2 crops to 4x your zinc, sphalerite, and bauxite.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSMD Circuit Components
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
SMD Circuit Components
Prequest requests:
Getting Your First Platinum
Avengers, Assemble! 2

allInOneQuestsList.name: SMD Inductors
allInOneQuestsList.data: Now that you have Neodymium you can make the last of the SMDs, the SMD inductor. It can replace Small Coils in your circuit crafting.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSMD Inductors
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
SMD Inductors
Prequest requests:
Find Bastnasite, Monazite and Neodymium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Some Rare High Tier Metals
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Platinum, Palladium, Iridium and Osmium can be extracted with a chemical reaction from Chalcopyrite and Pentlandite using sulfuric acid. You don't have the technology to process them properly right now but later on you need large amounts of them.

Note that this is not the proper method to get rare metals. This means none of them are pure, and cannot be utilized without the platline method, aside from EBF-ing platinum. Proper Platinum processing is EV, but you'll have to wait until IV to use the rest. Collecting a lot of it now (especially using this method) might not be a great idea depending on how long that will be.

[note]A Chemical Bath also extracts Platinum from Nickel Ore if you use Mercury. Time to head back to the Twilight Forest![/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSome Rare High Tier Metals
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Some Rare High Tier Metals
Prequest requests:
Nitric Acid
Ammonia

allInOneQuestsList.name: Soul Eater
allInOneQuestsList.data: Wouldn't it be great to actually make use of the intelligence or abilities a certain creature has? For example: enderman teleportation or brain capacity of a zombie for simple logic? (He doesn't use it anyway...) With this machine, you're able to bind a captured soul to an item, which can then be used in machines to improve their functionality, or create them to begin with.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSoul Eater

allInOneQuestsList.name: Specific Enchantments
allInOneQuestsList.data: Enchanting books is, just as it is for items, random. And that's annoying if you need a specific enchantment on your tool or armor. Now there's a way to actually select enchantments. For a price, obviously.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSpecific Enchantments

allInOneQuestsList.name: Styrene
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Putting Benzene and Ethylene in the Chemical Reactor gives you Styrene.

[note]And also hydrogen, just pack that away with the rest.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lStyrene

allInOneQuestsList.name: Styrene-Butadiene Rubber Sheet
allInOneQuestsList.data: Add sulfur to the raw dust to get molten styrene-butadiene rubber, then solidify it to get sheets.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lStyrene-Butadiene Rubber Sheet

allInOneQuestsList.name: Synthetic Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Want to make the synthetic rubber styrene-butadiene?

I'll show you a way you can get it. You'll need an Oil Cracker and a Distillation Tower. There are different ways to do it and this quest is only an example of how you can make it.

The first step is to crack your Naphtha with steam.

§6Already automated Styrene-Butadiene rubber or Polystyrene? Hold 128 sheets of each to skip their respective questline.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lSynthetic Rubber
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Synthetic Rubber
Prequest requests:
Performing Chemical Experiments at HV Level

allInOneQuestsList.name: Teflon Don
allInOneQuestsList.data:
To make PTFE, aka Teflon, you only need a few steps.

The first one is hydrofluoric acid. If you haven't reached the moon yet, the best sources for fluorine might be cryolite. Other options are treating Sand or Sandstone in a Chemical Plant for some Fluorite Ore, and centrifuging stone dust or black granite dust for biotite. You can also get small amounts from Lepidolite in salt veins and Mica. Mix it with some hydrogen to get hydrofluoric acid.

If you have reached the moon, you can also process Bastnasite ore.

§6Already automated PTFE? Hold 128 sheets to skip this questline.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lTeflon Don
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Teflon Don
Prequest requests:
Performing Chemical Experiments at HV Level

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tesla Would be Proud
allInOneQuestsList.data: Tired of sticking your EnderIO items in the capacitor bank to charge it? Time to make a wireless charger.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lTesla Would be Proud
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Tesla Would be Proud
Prequest requests:
A New Alloy, Soularium
Vibrant Alloy

allInOneQuestsList.name: Tetranitromethane
allInOneQuestsList.data: Bio diesel and diesel can be boosted using tetranitromethane. Ethenone and nitric acid are required to make tetranitromethane in a chemical reactor.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lTetranitromethane

allInOneQuestsList.name: The Creation of Life
allInOneQuestsList.data:
By utilizing large amounts of energy, you're able to reactivate those broken spawners you may have found in the past. If you haven't, you should get one of them now.

If the broken spawner isn't of the type of mob you want to spawn, you'll need to do some extra work. Capture one in a soul vial, then use that and the broken spawner in the soul binder to change the type. This takes forever, and also levels.

Combine a BS with your Powered Spawner in an anvil to set the type for it to spawn. Then you just gotta power it up!

If you set it to capture mode, you can make souls of a specific mob without any danger.

[note]Please try to use as few as possible on servers, mobs are laggy. Use crops if possible.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lThe Creation of Life
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
The Creation of Life

Soul Eater
Vibrant Crystals

allInOneQuestsList.data: Your first hull, as usual...

allInOneQuestsList.data: One of the most important machines in HV is the Universal Macerator. It has an additional output slot to get more materials when macerating ores. You want this, really, really, badly. If you get it, you can say goodbye to your Gallium worries!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lUniversal Macerator
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Universal Macerator

You're Gonna Hate This 1-4 in HV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Upgraded RF Batteries
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Capacitor Banks are upgraded RF batteries which can store the RF power you generate.

BTW, you can also use capacitors to upgrade your EnderIO machines. They'll use more power, but also work faster.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lUpgraded RF Batteries

allInOneQuestsList.name: UUMatter
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now you can actually make the UUM with a Mass Fabricator. Well, technically you could make it without UUA, but that's way more expensive. To make sure it only runs with UUA, put a programmed circuit (any value) in the machine's slot. UUMatter can be used for some very specific things, such as replicating §osome§r materials (check NEI, mostly/all periodic table), used with crops to create an ore, some specific high-level recipes need it, and...you can also sit in it to get regen.

The energy usage and overclocking of the Mass Fabricator is different from the usual GT way. To have fixed EU to UUM ratios for all tiers, the machine does perfect 2/2 overclocks. It also starts with a very high amperage in LV. The following chart should make it more clear:

Tier Amps EU/t Time
LV 8A 256 160
MV 4A 512 80
HV 2A 1024 40
EV 1A 2048 20
IV 0.5A 4096 10
etc.

Put in power (and hopefully UUA), and out comes UUM.

For now, just stockpile the UU matter. You need data orbs to use the replicator, and that's explained next tier.

[note]You only need to complete one of the tasks.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§lUUMatter

allInOneQuestsList.data: Vibrant alloy is a high tier EnderIO alloy made out of ender eye, energetic alloy and chrome dust.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§9§lVibrant Alloy
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Vibrant Alloy

allInOneQuestsList.data:
Your first EV circuit is the Workstation.

You can make Blue Alloy with Silver and Electrotine in an Alloy Smelter. If you don't have Electrotine, you can make it from Redstone and Electrum in a Mixer. Have fun!

Also note that using the fluid solidifier is way faster than the extruder for Blue Alloy.

allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§f§a§lAdvanced Ilmenite Processing

allInOneQuestsList.name: Advanced Mob Protection
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Like the chandelier, the magnum torch prevents monsters from spawning. However, its range is quite big, so a single one might be enough for your entire base. The range is 64 blocks horizontally in each direction, and 32 up and down.

[warn]Don't forget, monsters can still follow you home![/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lAdvanced Mob Protection

allInOneQuestsList.name: Appropriate Power
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Whether you used magic, steam, oil or biogas for power until now, you will run into problems as you advance to higher tiers. So you'll need to upgrade your power grid, at least for your EBF(s). So let's start with something more powerful: A nuclear reactor!

If you want to know how they work, refer to The Internet or the Reactor Planner at [url]https://github.com/MauveCloud/Ic2ExpReactorPlanner/releases[/url]

Note: The EU multiplier is set to 10x in this pack. That means your nuclear reactor is 10 times more efficient. Make sure to set the planner to GTNH mode under advanced. Also, the base numbers (before 10xing) can be seen on the hover text for all the components.

If you just want to use them, go to [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Nuclear_Reactors[/url] for reactor designs. The Thorium 1920 EU one is probably best for now.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lAppropriate Power

allInOneQuestsList.name: Back to Step 1
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Refined Platinum Salt can be heated to evaporate the last remaining impurities. Now you are left with PMP again, which you can use back in the first step again.

[note]Add an output hatch to the bottom layer of your EBF to capture the Chlorine for reuse.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lBack to Step 1
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Back to Step 1
Prequest requests:
Platinum Salt Recycling
Platinum Processing, Step 1

allInOneQuestsList.name: Basic Nuclear Fuel: Thorium
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The weakest of all fuel rods, but very easy to produce, very easy to keep cool and runs twice as long as uranium. It even returns 1/3 of the thorium back later. A perfect "fission and forget" power source.

[warn]Note: After they're used up you can recycle them to get Lutetium which is used for making americium in the fusion reactor. Americium is needed for top tier materials later, so start stockpiling now. Plus, you get power![/warn]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lBasic Nuclear Fuel: Thorium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Bigger Drums
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now that you have drums, you want them larger? Already??

Well, in that case, you better start collecting or making cobblestone, by the tens of thousands. And making explosives too.

Compress the cobblestone in an assembler first with circuit 1, then run them through the Implosion Compressor until you get Quadruple Compressed Cobblestone. Do that four times, and then another pass through the assembler with a diamond block, and there you have it - one bedrockium ingot.

Now do that 5 more times, and you can make yourself a bedrockium drum.

64k buckets of portable fluid. Perfect for your new Ore drill!

[note]There's also a Bedrockium ore much later on if you're lazy. By then you probably won't want the drums though.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lBigger Drums
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Bigger Drums
Prequest requests:
Want to Join a Band?

allInOneQuestsList.name: Bisphenol A
allInOneQuestsList.data: The next step towards Epoxid is to get Bisphenol A. You will need to combine Phenol, Acetone and HCl in a chemical reactor.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lBisphenol A

allInOneQuestsList.name: Blue Steel
allInOneQuestsList.data: Sunnarium batteries are made out of blue steel: a mixture of steel, black steel, brass and rose gold.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lBlue Steel

allInOneQuestsList.name: Create New Materials Out of Pure Energy
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Using the scanner, you can scan certain items (check the replicator's NEI recipes) to store the information of the item to a data orb so you can make copies of them with the replicator. This process uses a varying amount of UUM and time, depending on the item. Scanning also takes forever.

Some items you might want to replicate include:
Indium
Platline metals like Iridium and Osmium
Neon, Krypton, Xenon from liquid air distilling
Oganesson

For some things (Oganesson), this might be considered the only reasonable way of getting a decent amount.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lCreate New Materials Out of Pure Energy
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Create New Materials Out of Pure Energy
Prequest requests:
MV Field Generator

allInOneQuestsList.name: Critical Materials
allInOneQuestsList.data:
For more tungsten and tungstensteel, you'll want scheelite and tungstate. But the most important is desh, found only as small ore elsewhere, and used for the next rocket. Check Y 5-40.

[note]Since there's a good chance you have the MBM by now, you can do the crushed ore task instead of the ore one. This holds for other, similar quests.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lCritical Materials

allInOneQuestsList.name: Cutting Up Stuff at EV
allInOneQuestsList.data: Now that you've reached EV you're going to need a more advanced cutting machine. Better get one built.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §9§a§lCutting Up Stuff at EV

allInOneQuestsList.name: Data Orbs
allInOneQuestsList.data: Data Orbs are high tier data sticks to replicate materials or used as data storages.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lData Orbs

allInOneQuestsList.name: Dealing with Radiation
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Nuclear materials cause two types of radiation effects. One is a large number of standard debuffs. These can be removed the normal ways, with milk or terra wart or other methods that imitate them.

The other effect is a special Radiation unique debuff. This gets applied the longer you hold onto the radioactive item. Severely radioactive items can apply minutes of this deadly debuff. Regeneration might delay the inevitable death, but most regeneration sources aren't fast enough or long enough to keep you alive. You can try using an Amulet of Remedium to get rid of the effects. You should have one from your Moon trip, if not you'll have to dive into Thaumcraft to make one.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDealing with Radiation
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Dealing with Radiation
Prequest requests:
HEV Mark III Protective System

allInOneQuestsList.name: Dichlorobenzene
allInOneQuestsList.data:
To make higher tier cables, you'll have to use Polyphenylene Sulfide to coat them. Let's start with Dichlorobenzene.

§6Already automated Polyphenylene Sulfide? Hold 128 sheets to skip this questline.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDichlorobenzene

allInOneQuestsList.name: Dimensional goal: Deimos
allInOneQuestsList.data: You can actually get the ores you want from the other two, but visit if you like?
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDimensional goal: Deimos

allInOneQuestsList.name: Dimensional Goal: Mars
allInOneQuestsList.data: Mars has a few new ores you need to find like tungsten, uranium and desh. You can centrifuge uranium-238 for U-235 and plutonium-239, which can also be centrifuged to get Pu-241 if you happen to need it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDimensional Goal: Mars

allInOneQuestsList.name: Dimensional Goal: Phobos
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Phobos has new ores, go get them!

[note]Honestly, aside from the dungeon, Phobos has all the ores you need.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§k§l§r§a§lDimensional Goal: Phobos

allInOneQuestsList.name: Double the Fun
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Need even more power? Why not combine rods? Produces more power (NOT double, it varies per rod type) and more heat (again NOT double) but only uses up one slot. You need more complex designs to handle them, but you were ready for that, right?

So how about doubling your doubling to double your double (4x)? Quad rods put out even more power and heat, expect all the other rods to work similarly (for the most part).
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDouble the Fun
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Double the Fun
Prequest requests:
Basic Nuclear Fuel: Thorium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Draconium Egg
allInOneQuestsList.data: The next step is to add draconium and ender goo to the ender egg to get a draconium egg.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDraconium Egg

allInOneQuestsList.name: Dragon Egg Omlet
allInOneQuestsList.data: The last step to create a dragon egg is to add enderium using a dragon heart as a catalyst. It's not used up.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lDragon Egg Omlet

allInOneQuestsList.name: Egg Mutation
allInOneQuestsList.data: After you've gotten some mutagen try soaking your Big Egg in it along with some U-238.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEgg Mutation
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Egg Mutation
Prequest requests:
One Dragon Egg is Not Enough Mr Bond

allInOneQuestsList.name: Empty Epoxid Board
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Epoxid circuit boards require an epoxid plate, gold foil and sulfuric acid to make an empty board. By adding electrum foil and Iron(III) Chloride or Sodium Persulfate you can craft an Advanced Circuit Board.

[note]If you used IC2 Scrap Boxes to obtain the empty boards instead of using epoxy, hold 64 Advanced Circuit Boards in your hand to unlock this quest.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEmpty Epoxid Board

allInOneQuestsList.name: Empty Fiber Reinforced Glass Board
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Fiber Reinforced circuit boards require fiber-reinforced epoxid resin sheets, aluminium foil, and sulfuric acid to make an empty board. By adding energetic alloy foil and Iron(III) Chloride or Sodium Persulfate you can craft a More Advanced Circuit Board.

[note]With these new boards you can make Lapotronic Energy Orbs. You could use them to upgrade your LSC. The boards are also used in IV for the next circuit line.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEmpty Fiber Reinforced Glass Board
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Empty Fiber Reinforced Glass Board
Prequest requests:
Fiber Reinforced Epoxid Sheet

allInOneQuestsList.name: Ender Egg
allInOneQuestsList.data: Next, we need to start infusing it with the essence of The End. Start with endium dust and molten ender to get an ender egg.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEnder Egg

allInOneQuestsList.name: Epichlorohydrin
allInOneQuestsList.data: Epichlorohydrin is another product needed in your epoxid production. By now you should be experienced enough to figure out which path is best for your setup using NEI.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEpichlorohydrin

allInOneQuestsList.name: Epoxid
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Epoxid is needed for Advanced Circuits boards. You need Sodium Hydroxide, Epichlorohydrin and Bisphenol A to make it.

You can also use the molten form for some other things you might want to check out.

[note]Using a Large Chemical Reactor? You might be able to skip some steps, look around NEI to find out more.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEpoxid

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Assembler
allInOneQuestsList.data: An EV assembler is required to make lapotron crystals, coils, and other stuff.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEV Assembler
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
EV Assembler
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 1-4 in EV

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Chemical Bath
allInOneQuestsList.data: An HV chemical bath or better is needed for the quantum eye. If you make an EV one you can also process Ilmenite better.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§f§a§lEV Chemical Bath

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Chemical Reactor
allInOneQuestsList.data:
An EV chemical reactor is required to get some indium or make your radon production much faster. If you already made a large chemical reactor use that instead.

[note]Complete either task.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §b§a§lEV Chemical Reactor

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Circuit Assembler
allInOneQuestsList.data: An EV circuit assembler requires IV Circuits to craft. With this assembler you can make higher tier circuits.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §b§a§lEV Circuit Assembler
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
EV Circuit Assembler
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 5 and 6 in EV

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Field Generators
allInOneQuestsList.data:
With Field Generators you can make your first Quantum Chests or Quantum Tanks. But the first two should be for your T2 rocket.

[note]Note that the Assembler recipe is more resource efficient.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEV Field Generators

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Laser Engraver
allInOneQuestsList.data: An EV precision laser is required to make quantum crystals.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§k§r§a§lEV Laser Engraver
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
EV Laser Engraver
Prequest requests:
You're Gonna Hate This 5 and 6 in EV

allInOneQuestsList.name: EV Superconductors (2048 EU/t)
allInOneQuestsList.data:
How about lossless 2048 EU Wires? Uraniumtriplatinide is a superconductor wire and will transfer your energy without any loss.

You'll need TPV Coils.

[note]Whether these are worth it to save a little power or not is up to you of course.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEV Superconductors (2048 EU/t)
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
EV Superconductors (2048 EU/t)
Prequest requests:
Pure Uranium Ores
Reactor Fuels
Tungstensteel

allInOneQuestsList.name: EXTREME MIXING
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Well, maybe it's not as extreme as the quest name suggests, but it gets the job done.

You'll need one anyway so why not make one now and save some time on the mixing?
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lEXTREME MIXING

allInOneQuestsList.name: Fiber Reinforced Epoxid Sheet
allInOneQuestsList.data: Fiber Reinforced Epoxid Sheets are needed for More Advanced Circuit Boards. Mix glass fiber or carbon fiber with epoxid to get your sheets.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lFiber Reinforced Epoxid Sheet
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Fiber Reinforced Epoxid Sheet
Prequest requests:
Glass Fiber
Raw Carbon Fiber

allInOneQuestsList.name: Four fluids in the one Hatch!
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now that you're in EV tier you now have access to the Quadruple input hatches. These hatches can hold four different fluids in the one hatch which saves valuable spots in your multiblocks.

Perfect to be placed in your EBFs.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lFour fluids in the one Hatch!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Four fluids in the one Hatch!
Prequest requests:
Tier 4 (EV)

allInOneQuestsList.name: Glass Fiber
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Glass Fiber is used in Fiber Reinforced Boards for circuits. [note]For next tier. Go left for this tier's circuits.[/note]

Borax can be extracted out of Salt ores. Electrolyze it to get Boron and mix it with Glass dust to get Borosilicate Glass Dust.

The ingots can be turned into glass fiber in the wiremill or extruder.

You can also use borosilicate to make higher tier glass for higher tier SB recipes, or for the blocks for the multis that need it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lGlass Fiber

allInOneQuestsList.name: Graphene
allInOneQuestsList.data: Graphene is a material that is just one atom layer thick. It has very favorable electric properties. To create though you will have to make some Graphene you can use a powerful adhesive to pull a single layer of material away from Graphite.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§k§r§a§lGraphene

allInOneQuestsList.name: HEV Mark III Protective System
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Some items will give you a Radiation debuff without protection. How long it lasts depends on the item. Some items will give you an enormous or unlimited time debuff timer, which effectively kills you because there's no way to get rid of it.

Other items will give you a general sickness with many debuffs, but not Radiation. That can be removed the normal ways, Milk, Terrawart, Aqua bees, etc.

If you wear a Hazmat suit (and rubber boots!) you are not affected by radioactive effects at all. Same for some other armors that list hazmat protection.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lHEV Mark III Protective System
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
HEV Mark III Protective System
Prequest requests:
Appropriate Power

allInOneQuestsList.name: Higher Tier Cables
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Now you can use Polyphenylene Sulfide Foils and Silicone or Styrene-Butadiene Rubber to coat higher tier cables.
You'll need both Tungsten and Platinum in IV-tier.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lHigher Tier Cables

allInOneQuestsList.name: HSS-G
allInOneQuestsList.data:
After you craft an IV assembler, upgrade your Electric Blast Furnace with new Coils out of HSS-G Ingots. This ingot becomes even more very important in LuV tier. But right now both of these are still far away. Just make a bit that you need for the next rocket.

To find a Molybdenum Vein, you probably want to make a high quality Prospector's Scanner with a good range.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lHSS-G
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
HSS-G
Prequest requests:
TPV Coil Upgrade
Just Enough Tungstensteel For Your Rocket

allInOneQuestsList.name: Hypochlorous Acid
allInOneQuestsList.data: You'll need this for epichlorohydrin.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lHypochlorous Acid

allInOneQuestsList.name: Increasing the Capacity
allInOneQuestsList.data: To unleash the full potential of your reactor, you have to attach six reactor chambers to it.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lIncreasing the Capacity

allInOneQuestsList.name: Indium​
allInOneQuestsList.data:
At EV you're able to make Indium. Indium cannot be found in Ore form [note](except in super small amounts on Ross)[/note].

First you need to make Indium concentrate out of purified galena and sphalerite ore, then mix in some aluminium to get Indium. Indium is used in large amounts later on, automate this ASAP.

You also get lead, zinc, silver, sulfur, and water back from the lead-zinc solution. So it's not like you don't get the materials from the ores at all, just less of them.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lIndium

allInOneQuestsList.name: Just Enough Tungstensteel For Your Rocket
allInOneQuestsList.data:
OK, now you can:

1) Turn the Tungsten Trioxide into Hot Tungsten Ingots in the EBF with some Carbon
2) Keep going for TS

We want TS, so put some Hydrogen along with the Tungsten Trioxide in your EBF to get rid of the Oxygen.

Combine your pure Tungsten with Steel in a mixer to get Tungstensteel. Then EBF and then freeze it to get the Tungstensteel ingot.

Some of Tungstensteel Dust you don't need to smelt as you will want to use it for HSS-G!

[note]Note that Tungsten Trioxide to Tungsten Ingot has reduced smelt time. This does not apply to the pure version. You're gonna need a bunch of it in IV as well as the TS, so keep this in mind.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lJust Enough Tungstensteel For Your Rocket
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Just Enough Tungstensteel For Your Rocket
Prequest requests:
TPV Coil Upgrade
Tungstate Processing - Step 2

allInOneQuestsList.name: Lapotron Dust
allInOneQuestsList.data: Lapotron crystals require you to mix your energium dust with some lapis dust. You should check out the Storing and Transforming EU tab for the lapotron crystal and the Lapotronic Supercapacitor Multiblock.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lLapotron Dust

allInOneQuestsList.name: Monitoring Your Reactor
allInOneQuestsList.data:
It's important to monitor your reactor (Or just fancy to have a big screen somewhere...). So now that you've gained knowledge about the available fuel rods, you can start to build yourself a power plant. Here is something to help you out.

Use the sensor kit on the block you want to monitor, then put the sensor card in the display panel. Next select which lines of information you want to display.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lMonitoring Your Reactor

allInOneQuestsList.name: More Power Needed, Sir!
allInOneQuestsList.data: EBF and LCR recipes are going to need even more power. You'll need to craft EV energy hatches to supply them and keep them running.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §b§a§lMore Power Needed, Sir!
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
More Power Needed, Sir!
Prequest requests:
Cutting Up Stuff at EV
Just Enough Tungstensteel For Your Rocket

allInOneQuestsList.name: Move the Heat
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Heat exchangers are a passive way to pull heat from the reactor or adjacent components and spread it out across a wider area. Their performance is measured in heat units per tick (Hu/t), and there are a few different types that all work slightly differently. [note]Moving heat around is not enough on its own. Heat vents or coolant cells are required to actually dissipate it.[/note]

Heat Exchanger: Pulls 4 Hu/t from the reactor and 12 Hu/t from adjacent components.

Advanced Heat Exchanger: Pulls 8 Hu/t from the reactor and 24 Hu/t from adjacent components.

Reactor Heat Exchanger: Pulls 72 Hu/t from the reactor.

Component Heat Exchanger: Pulls 36 Hu/t from adjacent components.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lMove the Heat

allInOneQuestsList.name: MV Field Generator
allInOneQuestsList.data: Field Generators are powerful but expensive devices.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lMV Field Generator

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nano Assembly
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Nano Assembly is an EV circuit.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lNano Assembly

allInOneQuestsList.name: NanoCPU Wafer and Chip
allInOneQuestsList.data: The NanoCPU Wafer is made out of a CPU Wafer with raw carbon fiber and molten glowstone in an EV chemical reactor. Cut it for nano CPU chips.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lNanoCPU Wafer and Chip
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
NanoCPU Wafer and Chip
Prequest requests:
Empty Epoxid Board
Central Processing Unit

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nano Mainframe
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The Nano Mainframe is the first LuV Circuit, and the end of this circuit line produced in EV. To craft the Tier 2 Rocket and reach Mars, Phobos and Deimos, you need to reach this circuit and make 8 of it.

After that, you will be able to progress into IV much more easily, but you will need two more circuits to make the IV Circuit Assembling Machine.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lNano Mainframe

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nano Processor
allInOneQuestsList.data: This is the Nano Processor circuit line. Similar to the previous circuit line, these are four circuits. The §onano§r circuits go all the way to the LuV-tier Nano Mainframe.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lNano Processor
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Nano Processor
Prequest requests:
NanoCPU Wafer and Chip
EV Circuit Assembler

allInOneQuestsList.name: Nano Supercomputer
allInOneQuestsList.data: The Nano Supercomputer is an IV circuit.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lNano Supercomputer

allInOneQuestsList.name: No Boom Tomorrow
allInOneQuestsList.data:
With a nuke, you can cause some real catastrophic damage to your base. You can either place it 20 chunks away, or surround it with blast proof materials.

Fused Quartz is no good now, forget about it OK? Instead, use the GTNH approved Plated Reinforced Stone series! Or one of the other options I guess, like Warded Glass. You may need multiple layers depending on your reactor, try it out in creative. Remember you must close in the corners - blasts can slip through the cracks. To get power out, do right angle turns on the wires as blasts go in a straight line.

[note]There are 6 of them, use NEI.[/note]

[note]Okay, okay, you don't have to forget Fused Quartz, I'll give you some. Maybe you can stop rain with it.[/note]
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lNo Boom Tomorrow

allInOneQuestsList.name: One Dragon Egg is Not Enough Mr Bond
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Dragon eggs are very rare and only drop after a dragon's death. How about I show you a way to recreate this powerful item out of a monster spawn egg?

Let's start with step one. Using a mob spawn egg (any work, you can purchase one from the CCC tab if you do not have one), growth medium, and bacteria to create a bigger egg. This process needs one hour.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lOne Dragon Egg is Not Enough Mr Bond
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
One Dragon Egg is Not Enough Mr Bond
Prequest requests:
Ender Eyes​
Dimensional Goal: Mars
Cleanroom

allInOneQuestsList.name: Other Ores
allInOneQuestsList.data: You can find several other ores on these planets (some of which actually don't have a use, honestly), but the most useful right now are probably the ones on the right. There's also Draconium, Jade, Mirabilite, Tanzanite, Vinteum, and Vyroxes.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lOther Ores
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Other Ores
Prequest requests:
Dimensional Goal: Phobos
Dimensional goal: Deimos

allInOneQuestsList.name: Phenol
allInOneQuestsList.data:
The next circuit line requires Epoxid. To start, let's get some Phenol.

The easiest way is to get phenol out of heavy fuel. There are other ways, like getting it out of wood tar from a pyrolyse oven, isopropylbenzene and oxygen, or chlorobenzene and water.

§6Already automated Epoxid? Hold 128 sheets to skip this questline.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPhenol

allInOneQuestsList.name: Platinum Processing, Step 4
allInOneQuestsList.data: Platinum Chloride? You promised Pure Platinum Metal at a much higher efficiency than just smelting it! No worries, just react the Platinum Chloride with Calcium and you're done. The calcium and chlorine can be recycled as well!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPlatinum Processing, Step 4

allInOneQuestsList.name: Platinum Processing, Step 3
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Hooray! All my Platinum Metal is now a fluid.... Time to add the second chemical to recrystallize the dust.

You do different things with each of the results:

Reprecipitated Platinum: Go to step 4, the last step.
Platinum Salt: Go to the recycling step.
Palladium Enriched Ammonia: Keep it like the Platinum Residue until IV. Or process it now if you like, but you don't §oneed§r it until later.
Others: Can be reused.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPlatinum Processing, Step 3
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Platinum Processing, Step 3
Prequest requests:
Platinum Processing, Step 2b
Platinum Processing, Step 2a

allInOneQuestsList.name: Platinum Processing, Step 2b
allInOneQuestsList.data: Now, start with dissolving all the PMP into the Aqua Regia. You will also gain some Platinum Residue Dust. This highly concentrated dust contains a lot of even Rarer Metals, like Rhodium, Ruthenium, Osmium, and Iridium. You will need this at IV and higher, so stockpile it!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPlatinum Processing, Step 2b

allInOneQuestsList.name: Platinum Processing, Step 1
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Aqua Regia, the water of the Kings, is a chemical that will dissolve Platinum. The perfect solvent for Platinum processing. Get a few Cells of it.

§6Don't wanna do all these cell quests because you already automated it? Hold a stack of any platline dust to skip to the end of that chain.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPlatinum Processing, Step 1

allInOneQuestsList.name: Platinum Processing, Step 2a
allInOneQuestsList.data: Ammonium Chloride is used to precipitate the dissolved Platinum into a purer form, you'll need some of this.
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPlatinum Processing, Step 2a

allInOneQuestsList.name: Power of the Sun from Nuclear
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Your good old singleblock Molecular Transformer is gone. So how to obtain Sunnarium? Well there are a couple of ways, but at EV you'll need to radiate Glowstone and convert to Sunnarium.

The Glowstone rod will slowly charge up if you put it next to any fuel rod in your IC2 reactor. The exact charging speed is (number of rods adjacent) * (floor(hull temperature/3000) + 1) per second. A dual rod will count as 2 rods and quad fuel rod will count as 4 rods for this purpose. The Glowstone rod will neither emit heat, nor cause other component to emit more heat. You can treat this rod as a reactor plating in the IC2 Reactor Planner.

As you can see, the speed is directly proportional to hull temperature and rods adjacent. At the very extreme you can fully charge up a Glowstone rod in less than half a minute and output one Sunnarium every 10 second (on average, since cells aren't charged at same speed due to different position), but that require very considerable resource to set up. It also involves a vacuum freezer to cooldown the coolant cells and running the reactor at 66000+ hull temperature. Balance your need and your resource situation wisely. In any case, if you just wish to charge it up FAST then here is a possible string for the IC2 Reactor Planner:

erp=bpO50cpsdtJElVqn4hObFJc0tiOE0JpEHYpqTxJHvyezjSKRjUuwgouXzNOlU4a3hFBRygM=

Replace Containment Reactor Plating with actual Glowstone rods and you should be good to go. You can also use fewer reactor chambers by using less plating. Enjoy!
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lPower of the Sun from Nuclear
allInOneQuestsList.tooltip:
Power of the Sun from Nuclear

allInOneQuestsList.name: Radon Decay
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Radon is needed for EV Emitters and Sensors.

You can get Radium-226 from sifting Thorium, Pitchblende, Uraninite, or Uranium 238. It needs 4500 seconds, or 75 mins, to decay, and it will debuff you until it decays unless you have complete hazmat protection. It's a good idea to make a Lead-Lined Box and let the Radium decay there, instead.

Thorium can be obtained from the Nether, whereas the other 3 ores are locked after the Tier 2 Rocket. However, Thorium gives a much smaller chance of getting Radium, so you'll need a good amount of it to continue.

After it decays, you can electrolyze Radon out of it and progress into the next circuit line. However, you will not be able to do the Radon loop here, that can only be done with Plutonium 239.

[note]You only need to do one task.[/note]

Now, you have a way to do all of that.

Introducing the §6Redstone Sniffer§r!

For §cregular wireless redstone§f§r, the sniffer will list all currently used frequencies, tell you whether that frequency is private, and gives you an option to label it.

For §cadvanced wireless covers§f§r, the sniffer will additionally tell you where that cover is currently located, including in other dimensions, and offers you the option to also highlight or teleport to it.

allInOneQuestsList.name: Venting Heat
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Heat vents are a passive way to remove heat from your reactor. Their performance is measured in heat units per tick (Hu/t), and there are a few different types that all work slightly differently.

These heat vents simply cool themselves after absorbing heat from adjacent fuel rods and heat exchangers:

Heat Vent: Cools itself by 6 Hu/t

Advanced Heat Vent: Cools itself by 12 Hu/t

These heat vents absorb heat and cool themselves much like the ones above, but they also pull heat directly from the reactor core to themselves:

Reactor Heat Vent: Cools itself by 5 Hu/t and the reactor by 5 Hu/t

Overclocked Heat Vent: Cools itself by 20 Hu/t and the reactor by 36 Hu/t[note]Since it pulls more heat from the reactor than it dissipates, these are prone to melting if their heat is not balanced by a heat exchanger[/note]

The Component Heat Vent works differently to the other vents. Rather than absorbing heat and cooling itself or the reactor, it simply cools adjacent components (but not fuel rods) by 4 Hu/t
allInOneQuestsList.title: §a§lVenting Heat

You can also make the Air Intake Hatch - it's much better than spamming compressors!

Don't bother with the DT recipe unless you need the other fluids from it, it's not nearly as good as centrifuging. You also need the Liquid Air Fluid Hatch (only works with Liquid Air!) and Giant Output Hatch when you want to do that.

allInOneQuestsList.name: A Small Reward: The Infinite Spray Can
allInOneQuestsList.data:
Congratulations! You have completed the Platinum Line. Not many players have the perseverance to accomplish this task. A small reward is in order!

The [note]Infinite Spray Can[/note] never runs out of paint, and contains all sixteen colors (as well as solvent!) Of course, line mode and Ring of Loki support are included. There are also many convenience features. Middle-click to open a color choice GUI. Middle-click a painted block to copy its color to the spray can. Left-click to cycle the active color (sneak to go backwards.) Sneak-middle-click to lock the can; while locked, you can't accidentally change the color. Sneak-middle-click to unlock.

Naturally, you'll have to craft the infinite spray can yourself. It's a Dire Crafting recipe, so hopefully you have a dire crafting table. It requires a lot of platinum line materials, of course. And, apparently, a rainbow cactus, so a small detour into magic will be necessary. And a bunch of random-looking AE2 parts. And an IV world accelerator. And... a fence?

Is this really a reward?
allInOneQuestsList.title: §b§lA Small Reward: The Infinite Spray Can
